issues.summary: Support IAM Auth for Mongo DSCI
issues.description:
Change Request: Migrate MongoDB Atlas Authentication to AWS IAM

Migrate MongoDB Atlas authentication from username/password credentials to AWS IAM role-based authentication for GitHub Actions self-hosted runners in the VPC. This eliminates stored passwords, provides automatic credential rotation, and removes IP whitelisting delays.

Current State

Authentication Flow:

GitHub Actions (github-arc-runners)
→ MONGO_ATLAS_CONN_STR secret (username:password embedded)
→ 30-second IP whitelist delay (some workflows)
→ PyMongo MongoClient connects directly
→ MongoDB Atlas validates username/password

Limitations:

- Passwords stored in GitHub environment secrets (DEV, STG, PROD)

- IP whitelisting required (30-second delay in workflows)

- Manual credential rotation needed

- No audit trail for authentication via CloudTrail

Target State

Authentication Flow:

GitHub Actions (github-arc-runners)
→ GitHub OIDC token
→ aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials (assume IAM role)
→ Sets AWS_* environment variables
→ boto3.Session() automatically uses these credentials
→ PyMongo with MONGODB-AWS auth mechanism
→ MongoDB Atlas IAM database user validates AWS principal ARN
→ No IP whitelist delay needed

Connection String Change:

Traditional (Current):

mongodb+srv://username:password@cluster-dev.xxxxx.mongodb.net/gn_auth_dev?retryWrites=true&w=majority

IAM-Based (Target):

mongodb+srv://cluster-dev.xxxxx.mongodb.net/gn_auth_dev?authMechanism=MONGODB-AWS&retryWrites=true&w=majority

Benefits

1. Security:

- No passwords stored in GitHub secrets

- Automatic credential rotation via AWS STS

- AWS CloudTrail audit logging for database access

- Principle of least privilege via IAM roles

2. Performance:

- Eliminates 30+ second IP whitelisting delays in workflows

- Faster CI/CD pipeline execution

3. Operational:

- No manual credential rotation needed

- Simplified secret management

- Better compliance posture

Implementation Approach

Phased Rollout with Dual-Auth Support:

- Support both authentication methods during transition

- Migrate DEV → STG → PROD sequentially

- No breaking changes until explicit cutover per environment

- Traditional auth remains as emergency fallback during transition

Code Changes Summary

Files Modified:

- pyproject.toml - Added pymongo[aws]>=4.6.0 and boto3>=1.34.0

- gn_mongodb_migrations/db/connection.py - Dual authentication support

- .env.example - Documented both auth methods

- .github/workflows/*.yml - Added AWS credentials configuration step, removed IP delays

Key Features:

- Automatic detection of auth method from connection string

- Clear error messages for AWS credential failures

- boto3 automatic credential discovery (env vars, IAM role, AWS profile)

- Backward compatible with traditional username/password auth

8 files changed, 193 insertions(+), 51 deletions(-)

Rollback Plan

If IAM authentication fails in any environment:

- Immediate rollback (<5 minutes): Revert GitHub environment secret to traditional connection string. No code changes needed (dual-auth support maintained).

- Investigation: Check IAM role (aws sts get-caller-identity), verify Atlas IAM user configuration, review PyMongo error logs.

Timeline

- Week 1: DEV environment setup and testing

- Week 2: STG environment migration and validation

- Week 3-4: PROD environment migration with monitoring

- Week 5-8: Parallel operation validation period

- Week 8+: Decommission traditional auth

---
Acceptance Criteria

Phase 1: Code Changes ✅ COMPLETE

- ✅ Update pyproject.toml with pymongo[aws] and boto3 dependencies

- ✅ Refactor connection.py to support dual authentication (IAM + traditional)

- ✅ Update all GitHub Actions workflows with aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials step

- ✅ Remove IP whitelisting delay from schema generation workflows

- ✅ Update .env.example with comprehensive documentation for both auth methods

- ✅ Code committed to feature branch

Phase 2: MongoDB Atlas Configuration (DEV)

- Create IAM database user in MongoDB Atlas DEV project

- Verify AWS IAM role exists with GitHub OIDC trust policy

- Add AWS_MONGODB_ROLE_ARN variable to GitHub (DEV environment)

- Update MONGO_ATLAS_CONN_STR secret to IAM format (DEV)

Phase 3: DEV Environment Testing

- Run schema generation workflow successfully

- Run migration with --dry-run flag

- Run full migration deployment

- Verify all workflows complete without authentication errors

- Monitor for 2 days in DEV with no issues

Phase 4: STG Environment Migration

- Create IAM database user in MongoDB Atlas STG project

- Update AWS_MONGODB_ROLE_ARN variable (STG environment)

- Update MONGO_ATLAS_CONN_STR secret to IAM format (STG)

- Run full test suite including migrations and rollback

- Monitor for 3 days in STG with no issues

Phase 5: PROD Environment Migration

- Create IAM database user in MongoDB Atlas PROD project

- Update AWS_MONGODB_ROLE_ARN variable (PROD environment)

- Schedule maintenance window announcement

- Update MONGO_ATLAS_CONN_STR secret to IAM format (PROD)

- Run first migration under close monitoring

- Keep traditional credentials as emergency backup for 2 weeks

- Monitor for 1 week in PROD with stable operation

Phase 6: Verification & Success Metrics

- All GitHub Actions workflows execute successfully with IAM auth

- Local development works with AWS credentials

- Migration and rollback operations complete without errors

- No authentication failures for 1 week in PROD

- Workflow execution time reduced by 30+ seconds (no IP whitelist delay)

- CloudTrail logs capture database access events

Phase 7: Decommissioning (4 weeks after PROD)

- Remove username/password credentials from MongoDB Atlas

- Archive old GitHub secrets

- Update documentation (README, SETUP, architecture docs)

- Create troubleshooting runbook for on-call

---
Related Documentation

- MongoDB Atlas IAM Auth

- GitHub OIDC

issues.summary: Geosearch2.0 : optimization
issues.description:
We were seeing some higher memory usage in mongodb cluster that could be due to higher traffic. However we will investigate any query / index optimization that we can do to lower the memory usage.

# Search Page Faults Optimization

## Context
- Node1 memory elevation causing Search Page Faults spike
- 2.5M GeoLocation records, 29K PointOfInterest records
- Indexes: LOCATION_SEARCH_KEY_V2, POI_KEY_SEARCH_V2

## Tasks

### 1. [ ] Cap `take` parameter on GeoplacesController
- **File:** `Geosearch.API/Controllers/V1/GeoplacesController.cs`
- **Endpoints:** `/geoplaces/lookup` (line 55), `/geoplaces/city` (line 172)
- **Change:** Add `take = Math.Clamp(take, 1, 50)` at the top of both methods
- **Impact:** Prevents unbounded Atlas Search scans from a single request
- **Requires:** Code change only (no index rebuild)

### 2. [ ] Raise `minGrams` from 1 to 3 on autocomplete fields
- **Indexes:** `LOCATION_SEARCH_KEY_V2` (Name, Names, Admin1Name), `POI_KEY_SEARCH_V2` (Name, SearchKey)
- **Change:** `minGrams: 1` → `minGrams: 3` on all autocomplete fields
- **Impact:** ~40-60% reduction in search index size; eliminates single/double char gram explosion
- **Tradeoff:** Autocomplete won't return results until user types 3+ characters
- **Requires:** Index rebuild

### 3. [ ] Merge dual parallel Location aggregations into single query
- **File:** `Geosearch.Repository.Mongo/Repositories/GeoLocationRepository.cs` (lines 132-192)
- **Current:** Two `$search` aggregations run via `Task.WhenAll()` (location + postal), then merge/re-sort in memory
- **Change:** Combine into single `$search` compound query with `should` clauses for both postal and non-postal matches
- **Impact:** Halves concurrent index segment reads per request; reduces page fault pressure
- **Requires:** Code change only (no index rebuild)

### 4. [ ] Reduce `maxExpansions` from 50 to 20
- **Files:**
- `Geosearch.Repository.Mongo/Helpers/PoiQueryDefinitionHelper.cs` — 3 usages (TextSearchInACircle, TextSearchWithNear)
- `Geosearch.Repository.Mongo/Helpers/LocationQueryDefinitionHelper.cs` — 3 usages (TextSearchWithNear, PostalCodeSearchWithNear, TextSearchWithNearByCity)
- **Change:** `maxExpansions: 50` → `maxExpansions: 20` in all fuzzy configurations
- **Impact:** Fewer fuzzy variants per query = fewer index segment reads; minor tradeoff on typo tolerance
- **Requires:** Code change only (no index rebuild)

### 5. [ ] Add `.Limit()` and projections to unbounded POI queries
- **File:** `Geosearch.Repository.Mongo/Repositories/PointOfInterestRepository.cs`
- **Methods:**
- `FindPointOfInterestByAddressAndLocation` — no `.Limit()`, no projection, returns full documents
- `GetPointOfInterests(long[] ids)` — no `.Limit()`, no projection
- **Change:** Add reasonable `.Limit()` and projections to both methods
- **Impact:** Prevents unexpected large result sets from consuming memory
- **Requires:** Code change only (no index rebuild)

### 6. [ ] Reduce `maxGrams` from 10 to 7 on autocomplete fields
- **Indexes:** `LOCATION_SEARCH_KEY_V2` (Name, Names, Admin1Name, PostalCode), `POI_KEY_SEARCH_V2` (Name, SearchKey)
- **Change:** `maxGrams: 10` → `maxGrams: 7` on all autocomplete fields
- **Impact:** ~30% fewer stored grams per term; minimal user-facing impact since longer prefixes handled by `string` type mappings
- **Requires:** Index rebuild

issues.summary: Customer Care - Mass Cancellation
issues.description:
Confluence Documenation: https://golfnow.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/PD/pages/11360108565/Mass+Cancellation+System+-+Technical+Documentation

Summary:

Build a system that enables Member Care to cancel all reservations for a facility over a specific date or date range when a course is closed, including the ability to process optional refunds and support trade-times exclusions.

---
USE CASE:

When golf courses close for weather, maintenance, or emergency conditions, Member Care must currently cancel reservations manually which can be very tedious, especially at high traffic facilities. This Epic will deliver a mass-cancellation system that allows the team to select a date or date range, retrieve all impacted reservations, and perform multi-reservation cancellations with optional refund logic to drastically improve member care efficiency

This solution includes:

- A new Reservation Search API to retrieve reservations by facility, date range, and optional filters.

- A new Cancellation API that supports bulk cancellation of multiple Reservation IDs.

- A new dedicated GNC user interface for Member Care to run searches and perform cancellations.

This initiative improves operational efficiency, reduces manual errors, and provides consistent data and refund handling across the platform.

---
- Reservation Search API for Mass Cancellations

Create a new endpoint designed specifically for bulk retrieval of reservation data needed for mass closure workflows.

Requirements

- Inputs:

- FacilityID (required)

- StartDate (required)

- EndDate (required)

- OwnerID (optional)

- IncludeTrade (boolean; default = Not selected which means ALL) (optional - if not provided, default to include both)

- If false, trade times are excluded.

- If true, trade times are included.

- If not selected, Include both trade and course

2. Bulk Cancellation API Endpoint

Create a new endpoint to perform mass cancellation of multiple reservations in a single call, including refund control.

Requirements

- Inputs:

- ReservationIDs[] (required; array)

- SubmitRefund (boolean) (default to true)

- If false, cancel only (no refund action).

- If true, process refund

- RefundLocation (string; required if SubmitRefund = true)   Discussed with @Ryan Basyooni and decided to leave option as defaulting to always refund to Original Payment Method

- Allowed values:

- "OriginalPaymentMethod" - default this option

- "AccountBalance"

- CancelledByUserID (for tracking) - Log CRMSystemUserID in CRMTeeTimeReservation.ModifiedBy

- Output (per reservation):

- ReservationID

- CancellationStatus

- e.g., Cancelled, AlreadyCancelled, Failed, NotFound

- TeeSheetRemovalStatus

- Success/Failure

- RefundAmount

- RefundLocation

- Errors (if any)

- Include upstream Tee Sheet Service errors and refund processor errors.

Acceptance Criteria

- Cancels all valid reservations passed into the request.

- Handles upstream failures gracefully with per-reservation reporting.

- Refund logic executes only when SubmitRefund = true.

- Refund is processed to correct location (account vs. original payment).

- Cancellation writes appear in audit logs and customer histories.

- Endpoint responds within acceptable performance thresholds.

---

Mass Cancellation GNC Page (UI)

Build a Member-Care-facing interface in GNC allowing safe execution of mass cancellations.

Sections for Site:

- Date selector

- API Search Results section

- History Logs of passed Cancellations

---
User Story Block

- As a Member Care agent, I need a page to search reservations by facility and then date range and then perform bulk cancellation with full visibility into results.

---
SECTION 1: Date Selector

Requirements:

- Add new page: “Mass Cancellation Tool”

- Should be added to the following security groups: Admin and SuperAdmin (should be ID’s 37 and 49)

- Features:

- Facility selector (copies facility selector from other pages)

- Rate Set Drop Down (with All Rate Sets as default option)

- Toggle for IncludeTrade - Even though the facility selected is PlayFacility, if IncludeTrade is toggled, show all trade within the date range selected

- Date range selector (StartDate, EndDate) (copy logic from https://golfnowcentral.com/Reports/Reservations  )

-

SECTION 2: API RESULTS

- “Search” button returning results using API in https://golfnow.atlassian.net/browse/CORE-13945

- Display data from API results in a table that includes:

- ID

- Customer Name

- Tee Time

- Booked Date

- Players

- Rate Set

- Payment Details

- Each result should have a Checkbox to select individual reservations OR “Select All”

- Button: Cancel Selected

- Opens confirmation modal:

- SubmitRefund: yes/no

- The UI should always default to refunding back to original payment method even though the API can choose either. This is in case we need to make a change later, then we only need to add it to the UI.

SECTION 3: History Logs

- Add a section that acts as a sort of Changelog to show the user the past mass cancellations performed for the selected facility.

- Due to the potential massive amount of cancellations, results should be posted into a downloadable CSV file.

- Each mass cancellation result should have its own line item that has the following data:

- Date ranges of cancelled times

- number of tee times cancelled

- Refunded (Yes or No)

- CRMSystemUser.SystemUserID of person who made the cancellation

- Links to CSV file for download

- CSV file should include:

- ReservationID’s cancelled

- CRMTeeTime.TTDateTime of the ReservationID

- Cancellation status (Cancelled, Failed)

- Error if failed

- Refunded (Yes, No, Failed)

- If Yes, show the following

- Total amount paid

- Total amount refunded

- If no, skip

- If Failed, show the ChargeDetails Error

---
NOTES:

SubmitRefund true or false

IsRefund to original or Account Balance

Response:

array
{

Res ID: successfully refunded true or false. Successfully cancelled and removed from the tee sheet

Requirement:

Ensure all Nonrefundable logic is abided by - optional toggle - @Ryan Basyooni confirming with Ben and team on how to handle this?

AddOns (Sensible Weather and/or all future add-ons

QUESTIONS:

- How many max days should we allow mass cancellations? Ryan - Answer: 7 Day Limitation to mitigate risk

- Include Trade or not - Ask Ryan should trade always be included in this workflow? Answer Default to Both - allow optional param

- ChannelID selector? or default to all Answer Default to all - Allow option param. likely will leave out of the GNC UI

NOTES:
warning message to user

Does the response work in a Queue and run in background like the mass update queue and populate the message center? Section for History that stores logs of all updates per facility and auto-deletes the after 365 days

results posted as a file.

issues.summary: GolfPass Auto Renewal Save Offer
issues.descriptionHtml:
The D2C team would like to offer an alternate product to a customer if they are attempting disable auto-renew on the front end in an attempt to keep them in a GolfPass subscription but maybe at a discounted price or a lower tier. The front end team would need an API that returns a ProductId, ProductPriceId, ProductTypeId for the best product offer based on the below requirements.

  • Potential Request Example: GET /subscription/{CUSTOMERSUBSCRIPTIONID}/renewal-product-offer?cancellationReasonId={CANCELLATIONREASONID}

  • Response Example:

    • [{
	"ProductTypeId":9,
	"ProductId": 36,
	"ProductPriceId": 655
}]

The API would return the most applicable product based primarily on the cancellation reason of the subscription (provided by client). So we would need a database mapping of Current ProductPriceId → Cancellation Reason → Product Offer

  • Example: Current ProductPriceId=64 → Reason=Too Expensive → ProductOffer=9,36,655

  • Include an IsActive field for each row

    • Deleting/nulling from the UI should update IsActive to 0

  • We should build a UI in GNC so the D2C team can control this as products change over time

    • Design Attached

    • Located on the current Product Price Edit/Create Page

    • These are not required fields

    • These should default to NULL/empty

    • Copying an existing product should carry the values over

    • If a value is submitted, insert/update the the mapping table created

    • If the field was previously populated and on the UI it was erased, update IsActive to 0

    • List out all the disable reasons with input boxes next to them

      • [
        {
            "CancellationReasonId": 1,

issues.summary: Platform Docs Site Setup
issues.description:
Background

We have historically struggled to maintain clear and useful API documentation for external partners (and even internal folks). To remedy this, we will begin deployment of an https://www.mkdocs.org/ based website that will host API reference material for teams to integrate with.

User Story

As a GolfNow developer, I want to be able to write API documentation for projects such as the Order Processing API or Inventory API in order to support integration with our API platform.

Tasks

issues.description:
Analyze and optimize the cancellation worAnalyze and optimize the cancellation workflow for GolfNow’s prime tee sheets to identify and resolve root causes of “Cancel Assist” errors.

issues.summary: Modernize Affiliate API dependencies to remediate security vulnerabilities
issues.description:
Modernize the Affiliate API's application dependencies and supporting configuration to remediate identified security vulnerabilities and improve compatibility with .NET Framework 4.8.

Changes

- Updated and revalidated application dependencies to ensure compatibility with .NET Framework 4.8.

- Corrected package, assembly, and analyzer references impacted by dependency upgrades.

- Modernized and consolidated dependency injection configuration used throughout the application.

- Added and corrected service registrations required for application startup and runtime dependency resolution.

- Improved application startup and configuration initialization to align with current dependency versions.

- Removed obsolete configuration artifacts and legacy project references that were no longer required.

- Reviewed and updated client-side dependency configuration and JavaScript resources.

- Evaluated Bootstrap and front-end dependencies while preserving compatibility with the existing Bootstrap 3 user interface.

- Investigated reported security vulnerabilities, including a Handlebars vulnerability, and verified that Handlebars is not directly referenced or loaded by the application.

- Improved maintainability, readability, and consistency of application configuration and dependency management.

issues.summary: Update cancellation/refund logic to refund player slots in descending order
issues.description:
Reservation Service currently handles cancellations by cancelling the highest player number first. For example in a 4 player reservation. A one player cancellation will remove the 4th slot. However when refunding, specifically in SendOrderToInterface workflows and sending data back to BRSG/EZRTS, we refund player slot 1 first. So this creates a mismatch. We need to update refund logic to match cancellation logic.

- VendorService GetBookingInfo now has a Status field

- cancelled = refund eligible

- active = refund eligible

- refunded = already refunded and not eligible

- Logic

- When refunding, look for the player slot numbers in descending order and refund the amount with the largest slot number with a status of cancelled

- If no statuses are set to cancelled, look for the player slot numbers in descending order and refund the amount with the largest slot number with a status of active

- If no statuses of cancelled or active exist, throw an exception - This would likely be a super edge case - please confirm with Desimo and B2B QA if this is even possible

- Happy Path Testing

- Book a 4 player reservation with Send Order to Interface Enabled

- Cancel and refund one player through GNC

- Expect to see the 4th player slot removed from the tee sheet

- Expect to see player 4s green fee refunded in the Order

- Work with B2B QA on various other testing scenarios and tee sheet validation

- Merge the Hold Period UI with the Autoload UI for LIT-enabled rate sets

- When a rate set has LIT enabled:

- Hold periods must display on the Autoload page

- Hold periods must continue to display on the existing Hold Period page

- Ensure both views reflect the same underlying hold data (no duplication or drift)

- Any changes made on one page will subsequently update on the other UI as well

Acceptance Criteria

- LIT-enabled rate sets automatically surface hold periods in Autoload UI

- Hold periods shown in Autoload and Hold Period pages remain in sync

- No additional manual configuration required to manage LIT hold periods

- Existing non-LIT behavior remains unchanged

issues.summary: API Errors with Overlapping Facility Closures causes Duplicate Tee Time Rate Details
issues.description:
Summary
A customer using the GolfNow mobile app sees a raw WCF/SOAP fault popup when opening golf course pages. The visible screen is the course tee-time screen, but the failing backend request is the authenticated customer reservation-history call:

/rest/customers/edomin2@gmail.com/reservations?channelid=5151&expand=Facilities&take=17&skip=0&sort-direction=asc

The API throws:

System.ArgumentException: An item with the same key has already been added.
at System.Linq.Enumerable.ToDictionary(...)
at GolfNow.API.Business.Reservation.ReservationProvider.SearchReservations(...)

Impact
This appears isolated to golfer edomin2@gmail.com / CustomerNumber = 23667034, but it can occur for any customer whose reservation history includes a tee time duplicated by overlapping facility closure map rows. Because the failing request is customer-level and runs across course pages, the same customer can see the error when opening any facility.

Root Cause
Customer reservation 418289152 references TeeTimeID = 2026769635. That tee time overlaps two active FacilityClosurePlayFacilityMap rows for play facility 7002:

ID 123099 | 2026-01-02 to 2026-03-20 | IsActive = 1 | IsWalkingOnly = 1
ID 124941 | 2026-02-09 to 2026-02-12 | IsActive = 1 | DisableInventory = 1

Inventory.CRMTeeTimeSelect joins to FacilityClosurePlayFacilityMap on active rows where TTDateTime BETWEEN StartDate AND EndDate. Since both rows match, the proc returns two rows for the same TeeTimeID.

GolfNowAPI then converts rate details into a dictionary keyed by BigTeeTimeRateId:

var rateDetails = teeTimeInventoryService.GetTeeTimeRateDetails(rateIds)
.ToDictionary(rd => rd.BigTeeTimeRateId);

Because duplicate rows are returned for BigTeeTimeRateId = 2026769635, ToDictionary throws and the reservation-history API returns a server fault.

Evidence
ErrorLogID:

26922733

Failing request:

customers/edomin2@gmail.com/reservations?channelid=5151&expand=Facilities&take=17&skip=0&sort-direction=asc

Customer:

CustomerNumber: 23667034
CustomerID: 5AF183FC-A024-4831-87FD-826BFA1CB293
Email: edomin2@gmail.com

Bad reservation / tee time:

ReservationID: 418289152
TeeTimeID: 2026769635
OwnerID: 5151
PlayDate: 2026-02-10 09:40

Duplicate source:

FacilityClosurePlayFacilityMap rows matching TeeTimeID 2026769635: 2

Code references:

- ReservationProvider.cs

- [InventorySearchDao.cs](/Users/206416620@bwt3.com/Desktop/gn-main/Internal Services/GolfNow.Services.Inventory/GolfNow.Services.Inventory.DAL/DAO/InventorySearchDao.cs:442)

- Inventory.CRMTeeTimeSelect

Expected Result
Customer reservation-history API should return successfully even if a historical tee time overlaps multiple facility closure map rows.

Actual Result
API throws duplicate dictionary key exception and returns a raw server fault, which mobile displays to the customer.

Recommended Fix
Primary backend fix: update Inventory.CRMTeeTimeSelect so FacilityClosurePlayFacilityMap cannot multiply tee-time rows. Use OUTER APPLY TOP (1) or otherwise collapse applicable closure rows to one row per tee time.

Defensive API fix: make ReservationProvider.SearchReservations resilient to duplicate rate detail rows:

var rateDetails = teeTimeInventoryService.GetTeeTimeRateDetails(rateIds)
.GroupBy(rd => rd.BigTeeTimeRateId)
.ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.First());

Data cleanup: review and resolve overlapping active FacilityClosurePlayFacilityMap records for play facility 7002, especially IDs 123099 and 124941.

Secondary mobile fix: do not display raw WCF/SOAP fault XML to users; show a friendly generic error or suppress this non-critical companion failure.
issues.descriptionHtml:
Summary
A customer using the GolfNow mobile app sees a raw WCF/SOAP fault popup when opening golf course pages. The visible screen is the course tee-time screen, but the failing backend request is the authenticated customer reservation-history call:

/rest/customers/edomin2@gmail.com/reservations?channelid=5151&expand=Facilities&take=17&skip=0&sort-direction=asc

The API throws:

System.ArgumentException: An item with the same key has already been added.
at System.Linq.Enumerable.ToDictionary(...)
at GolfNow.API.Business.Reservation.ReservationProvider.SearchReservations(...)

Impact
This appears isolated to golfer edomin2@gmail.com / CustomerNumber = 23667034, but it can occur for any customer whose reservation history includes a tee time duplicated by overlapping facility closure map rows. Because the failing request is customer-level and runs across course pages, the same customer can see the error when opening any facility.

Root Cause
Customer reservation 418289152 references TeeTimeID = 2026769635. That tee time overlaps two active FacilityClosurePlayFacilityMap rows for play facility 7002:

ID 123099 | 2026-01-02 to 2026-03-20 | IsActive = 1 | IsWalkingOnly = 1
ID 124941 | 2026-02-09 to 2026-02-12 | IsActive = 1 | DisableInventory = 1

issues.description:
Summary

The GN AU (GolfNow Australia) consumer password reset email is rendering with the "GolfNow for Business" B2B logo instead of the correct consumer logo.

Impact

Consumer-facing branding issue — AU golfers resetting their http://GolfNow.com.au  password see a business/merchant-facing logo, which is confusing and off-brand.

Root Cause

The asset on Akamai at the URL referenced by the email template is using an outdated image URL.

Template reference: DotNet2/GolfNow.Notification/GolfNow.Notification.Send/Templates/PasswordReset.xslt, line 2461 (Qantas/AU branch)

- Replace the image URL with: https://vs-i8p7v6z9.akamaized.net/content/email/images/GN_Euro_Logo.png

Verification

After remediation, trigger a password reset on a http://GolfNow.com.au  account and verify the header image renders as the standard GolfNow logo

issues.summary: Support PayStack SCA
issues.description:
We currently support SCA validations for Stripe payments. We now need to support a new provider. The goal of this is to have Paystack provider use the same API2.1 and Staging flow as Stripe so there is no impact to the various UIs.

Documentation: https://golfnow.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/TEC/pages/10476486659/Paystack+Implementation+using+3DS

Differences:

- Paystack not only supports a redirect URL (similar to Stripe), it also supports the ability to have multiple user inputted validations steps.

- The Payments team will manage/support the UI to enter various validation datapoints

- Path #1 - Similar to Stripe

- User gets SCA validation

- User validates from the provided URL

- User is redirected back to checkout to complete transaction

- Path #2

- User gets SCA validation and it opens URL to enter their birthday

- User enters birthday

- User gets secondary validation to enter phone number

- User enters phone number

- User is redirected back to checkout to complete reservation

issues.summary: Submit T&Cs to CustomerSubscription record upon purchase
issues.description:
We will be legally required to store the T&Cs at time of product purchase so we can prove what the user agreed to at a specific time.

- OrderCheckout - https://rc2-api.gnsvc.com/GolfNowAPI.svc/rest/channel/5151/customers/{{EmailAddress}}/orders

- Upon successful purchase, log the terms text of the purchased product to Product.Purchase table

- Also log the VersionNumber of the template for the applicable terms text

- The T&Cs will likely have date and price variables in them, the text stored needs to include the variables at time of purchase, not at time of calling for the data post transaction

- The response fields would be ProductTerms

- Logic for Checkout:

- Validate the PPID in the request of the checkout

- Validate the ChannelID that matches the request

- Submit the terms text and version number that matches the above two validations

issues.description:
- Design: Attached

- Sample Pages Affected:

- Edit PPID: https://rc2-www.golfnowcentral.com/Administration/ProductPricingEdit?productId=42&productPricingId=685

- Create PPID: https://rc2-www.golfnowcentral.com/Administration/ProductPricingEdit?productId=47&productPricingId=-1

- Add a new Section Header below Tags and above Owner Settings

- Section Header: Terms & Conditions

- New Field Label: Applicable Owner Group

- This will be an owner selection box similar to lower on the page

- For new PPID creation, one box should pre-populate as empty on the page

- Add a button below the box that says “Add Applicable Owner Group”

- Clicking the button should open a new empty Applicable Owner Group box

- There can be multiple Applicable Owner Group boxes because one PPID can be configured with multiple T&Cs texts depending on the channel

- Drop down Box Label: T&Cs Template

- This should be to the right of the Applicable Owner Group box

- There should only be one of these per Applicable Owner Group

- One Applicable Owner Group can only have one T&Cs template

- You can use the same Template for multiple Applicable Owner Groups

- Drop down box list will be the Template Names created in https://golfnow.atlassian.net/browse/CORE-13302

- Selecting a template will display the Template Body from https://golfnow.atlassian.net/browse/CORE-13302 below the drop down box

- This should default to a NONE selection for new creations

- DoubleOptInContext

- This should be a checkbox to identify how the copy should be exposed in the API https://golfnow.atlassian.net/browse/CORE-13299

- It should be Read Only unless you have edit permissions

- Requirements:

- For ProductTypeId=9, this will be a required field when creating a new product or editing an existing

- For all other ProductTypes, this is not required

- Display an error message like “Please select a Terms & Conditions template for this Product Price Id” if you attempt to save/create without updating

- Add a delete button to the left of Applicable Owner Group

- There should only be a delete button on 2nd, 3rd, 4th etc rows because the first row is always required

- This delete action should delete the entire row

- When creating a new product, the page should load with one Applicable Owner Group box and T&Cs Template dropdown  visible by default

- When Copying an existing PPID, this should copy the previously selected configurations as well

- An OwnerId cannot exist in two separate Applicable Owner Groups within one PPID

- Saving/Creating the PPID on this page should submit the TemplateId to the PPID Relational table created in https://golfnow.atlassian.net/browse/CORE-13302

issues.summary: Rate Periods - Disable the Affiliate Source Owner ID for Simulator Rate Sets
issues.description:
Background

When a facility is activated as a Simulator, the system should not default releasing to the Affiliate Source Owner ID. Additionally, Owner-related fields should not be available when the associated Rate Set is configured as a Simulator.

Currently, users are still able to select Affiliate Customer Group ID and Owner fields on the Rate Periods page and they also are enabled by default.

---
Requirements

1. Prevent Default Behavior

- When a facility is activated as a Simulator, the system must not default releasing to Affiliate Source Owner ID.

2. Disable Owner Fields for Simulator Rate Sets

- If a Rate Set Type = Simulator:

- Disable Owner Group for Affiliates

- Prevent selection of Affiliate Customer Group ID on the Rate Periods page

3. UI Behavior

- On the Rate Periods page:

- If the associated Rate Set is marked as Simulator:

- Affiliate Customer Group ID field must be:

- Disabled (read-only), or

- Hidden (preferred approach to be confirmed)

- Owner-related fields must be:

- Disabled or hidden

- Users should not be able to override this behavior

---
Acceptance Criteria

- Given a Rate Set with Type = Simulator
When a user navigates to the Rate Periods page
Then the Affiliate Customer Group ID field is disabled or not selectable.

- Given a Rate Set with Type = Simulator
Then Owner ID and Owner Group fields are disabled or hidden.

- Given a facility activated as a Simulator
Then the system does not default releasing to Affiliate Source Owner ID.

- Given a non-Simulator Rate Set
Then existing Owner and Affiliate selection behavior remains unchanged.

issues.summary: Create GNC Page to Showcase Locked In Trade Holds
issues.description:
As a Revenue manager, I would like the ability to have visibility and editability for all of the locked in trade holds on a given rate set.

currently, there is no way to see what trade holds are present on a rate set without them loading in tee times and hoping that the time that is loaded is on the same slot as the trade hold. Typically, they are having to log into the tee sheet to confirm.

For this ticket, we need to add a new GNC page under the Inventory tab that shows all of the upcoming trade holds for that given rate set.

---
Also, there needs to be a way to edit these trade holds on a case by case basis (one hold at a time). They should be able to manually enter a new tee time on each of them, as well as just cancel them off the tee sheet.

---
Detailed Requirements - Post-meeting with Revenue:

- Change Name of existing Page - “Trade Reservation Hold - Configuration”

- New page would be “Trade Reservation Hold - Update”

- Show Both the Live Trade time and the Hold time and status of each (as indicated by the player icons on the corresponding live time from Update Tee times)

- Allow user to edit by typing over the Hold Time to make a change to the hold time

- this should adopt same text logic as Update Tee times

- This will trigger the API to instantly attempt a Cancel Hold and Create Trade Hold at the new time

- Include Roll Logic to attempt to create a hold at the nearest available tee time if the new hold time is not available

- Show the user the response from these changes in a popup window on the page

- Show the Create Hold API response if the Cancel is successful. Either successful message or the error if present.

- Show the user the error from the cancel Hold endpoint if this fails so that they know why they cannot make the change

- Research the ability to also update the Trade Live time if possible. Potentially at the very least, provide a redirect link to the tee time Details page to make the update there

- Also provide a button to cancel the hold for each individual hold time

- At the bottom of the page, show the Trade Hold Period Rate Fence

- this should always show the current days rate fence

---

issues.descriptionHtml:
As a Revenue manager, I would like the ability to have visibility and editability for all of the locked in trade holds on a given rate set.

currently, there is no way to see what trade holds are present on a rate set without them loading in tee times and hoping that the time that is loaded is on the same slot as the trade hold. Typically, they are having to log into the tee sheet to confirm.

For this ticket, we need to add a new GNC page under the Inventory tab that shows all of the upcoming trade holds for that given rate set.

Also, there needs to be a way to edit these trade holds on a case by case basis (one hold at a time). They should be able to manually enter a new tee time on each of them, as well as just cancel them off the tee sheet.

Detailed Requirements - Post-meeting with Revenue:

  1. Change Name of existing Page - “Trade Reservation Hold - Configuration”

    1. New page would be “Trade Reservation Hold - Update”

  2. Show Both the Live Trade time and the Hold time and status of each (as indicated by the player icons on the corresponding live time from Update Tee times)

  3. Allow user to edit by typing over the Hold Time to make a change to the hold time

    1. this should adopt same text logic as Update Tee times

    2. This will trigger the API to instantly attempt a Cancel Hold and Create Trade Hold at the new time

    3. Include Roll Logic to attempt to create a hold at the nearest available tee time if the new hold time is not available

  4. Show the user the response from these changes in a popup window on the page

    1. Show the Create Hold API response if the Cancel is successful. Either successful message or the error if present.

    2. Show the user the error from the cancel Hold endpoint if this fails so that they know why they cannot make the change

  5. Research the ability to also update the Trade Live time if possible. Potentially at the very least, provide a redirect link to the tee time Details page to make the update there

  6. Also provide a button to cancel the hold for each individual hold time

  7. At the bottom of the page, show the Trade Hold Period Rate Fence

    1. this should always show the current days rate fence

issues.summary: Capture Pre-Block TTDateTime in Inventory Automated Refresh Process
issues.description:
Summary

When Inventory Automated Refresh (IAR) blocks a trade time and rolls it to a new time slot, the parent tee time's TTDateTime is overwritten to 23:00 (11pm), erasing the original play time. Revenue analytics need to track where trade times moved FROM (the pre-block time) to analyze inventory movement patterns and revenue impact.

Request: Capture and log the parent tee time's TTDateTime value BEFORE overwriting it to 23:00, so revenue analytics can build a complete paper trail of all tee time movements.

---
Business Context

Requesting Team

Data Science - Revenue Analytics (Dalton, Allegretti)

Use Case

DS-21792: Track tee time movements caused by inventory refresh to understand:

- How often trade times move from morning slots to afternoon slots

- Revenue impact when times are pushed to less desirable slots

- Effectiveness of Inventory Automated Refresh in returning times to original load times

- Pattern analysis for capacity planning

Current Limitation

Revenue team has a fact table that captures price changes from TTHistory, but cannot track time movements because:

- TTHistory logs: "Tee time inserted by InventoryAutomatedRefresh based on TeeTimeIDs: 123456"

- Parent TeeTimeID can be identified (123456)

- But: Parent's TTDateTime is already 23:00 by query time (overwritten during block)

- Result: No way to determine what time slot the tee time moved FROM

---
Expected Behavior (After Enhancement)

When IAR blocks a trade time and rolls it to a new slot:

- Before overwriting parent TTDateTime to 23:00:

- Read current TTDateTime value

- Include it in the TTHistory entry for the NEW tee time

- Updated TTHistory format:

Tee time inserted by InventoryAutomatedRefresh based on TeeTimeIDs: 123456 (PriorTime: 2026-04-15 14:30:00)

- Alternative format (if clearer):

Tee time inserted by InventoryAutomatedRefresh from 2:30 PM based on TeeTimeIDs: 123456

Parsing Example

Revenue analytics can parse TTHistory to reconstruct movement chain:

TeeTimeID  Created              TTHistory
---------- -------------------- ----------------------------------------------------------
2093781359 2026-03-20 10:00:00  "TeeTimeLoadID: 49670142"                    → 10:00 AM
2096365430 2026-03-28 17:13:03  "...based on TeeTimeIDs: 2093781359 (PriorTime: 10:00)"  → 2:00 PM
2109595319 2026-03-31 09:45:12  "...based on TeeTimeIDs: 2096365430 (PriorTime: 14:00)"  → 11:00 AM

Movement chain: 10am → 2pm → 11am

---
Current Behavior

TTHistory captures:

- Source TeeTimeID(s) that were consolidated: "based on TeeTimeIDs: 123456, 789012"

- Event type: "Tee time inserted by InventoryAutomatedRefresh"

- Timestamp of new tee time creation

TTHistory does NOT capture:

- The TTDateTime value of source tee time(s) before block

- Reason: Parent tee time's TTDateTime is overwritten to 23:00 during block process

- By the time revenue analytics queries, original time slot information is lost

---
Proposed Solution

Implementation Approach

Location: Cache Manager/3.0/GolfNow.Inventory.CacheAndSync.Domain/Sync/TradeTimes.cs (Inventory Automated Refresh logic)

Change: Capture pre-block TTDateTime and append to history string

Current code (approximate location line ~1047):

var log = String.Format("Tee time inserted by InventoryAutomatedRefresh based on TeeTimeIDs: {0}",
string.Join(" , ", originalTeeTimes.Value.Select(r => r.Item2.ID.ToString()).ToList()));

Enhanced code:

// Capture pre-block TTDateTime values
var teeTimeDetails = originalTeeTimes.Value
.Select(r => $"{r.Item2.ID} (PriorTime: {r.Item2.DateTime:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss})")
.ToList();

var log = String.Format("Tee time inserted by InventoryAutomatedRefresh based on TeeTimeIDs: {0}",
string.Join(" , ", teeTimeDetails));

// Result: "Tee time inserted by InventoryAutomatedRefresh based on TeeTimeIDs: 123456 (PriorTime: 2026-04-15 14:30:00), 789012 (PriorTime: 2026-04-15 14:30:00)"

---
Implementation Details

Files to Modify

Primary Change:

- Cache Manager/3.0/GolfNow.Inventory.CacheAndSync.Domain/Sync/TradeTimes.cs

- Line ~1047: Enhance log string to include PriorTime

Data Model:

- CRMTeeTime.TTHistory field (varchar) - existing field, no schema change

- Format: Append (PriorTime: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss) to existing log string

---
Testing & Verification

Test Scenario 1: Single Source Tee Time

- AutoLoad creates trade time at 8:00 AM (TeeTimeID: 1000)

- IAR blocks and rolls to 10:00 AM (creates TeeTimeID: 2000)

- Verify: TeeTimeID 2000 TTHistory contains: "...based on TeeTimeIDs: 1000 (PriorTime: 2026-05-20 08:00:00)"

- Verify: TeeTimeID 1000 TTDateTime is now 23:00

Test Scenario 2: Multiple Source Tee Times (Consolidation)

- IAR consolidates TeeTimeID 1000 (2:00 PM) and 1001 (2:00 PM) → creates 2000 (2:00 PM)

- Verify: TeeTimeID 2000 TTHistory contains both source times with PriorTime values

- Verify: Both 1000 and 1001 have TTDateTime = 23:00

Test Scenario 3: Multi-Step Roll Chain

- TeeTime 1000 at 8:00 AM → rolled to TeeTime 2000 at 2:00 PM

- TeeTime 2000 at 2:00 PM → rolled to TeeTime 3000 at 11:00 AM

- Verify: Can reconstruct chain: 8am → 2pm → 11am

Validation Query

-- Parse TTHistory to extract PriorTime
SELECT
tt.TTTeeTimeID,
tt.TTDateTime AS CurrentTime,
h.History,
-- Extract PriorTime using string parsing
CASE
WHEN h.History LIKE '%PriorTime:%'
THEN SUBSTRING(h.History,
CHARINDEX('PriorTime: ', h.History) + 11,
19)  -- 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss' = 19 chars
ELSE NULL
END AS PriorTime
FROM CRMTeeTime tt
JOIN CRMTeeTimeHistoryDetail h ON h.TeeTimeID = tt.TTTeeTimeID
WHERE h.History LIKE '%InventoryAutomatedRefresh%'
ORDER BY h.Timestamp;

---
Acceptance Criteria

- History Capture

- [ ] When IAR blocks/rolls a trade time, new tee time's TTHistory includes PriorTime for source tee time(s)

- [ ] Format: "Tee time inserted by InventoryAutomatedRefresh based on TeeTimeIDs: {ID} (PriorTime: {TTDateTime})"

- [ ] Multiple source tee times: All listed with respective PriorTime values

- Data Accuracy

- [ ] PriorTime value matches source tee time's TTDateTime BEFORE block operation

- [ ] Timestamp format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss (SQL-friendly, unambiguous)

- Edge Case Handling

- [ ] Source tee time with TTDateTime = 23:00 → logs as PriorTime: 23:00 (not skipped)

- [ ] Multiple source tee times → all captured in single history string

- [ ] TTHistory varchar length validated (no truncation)

- Parsing Validation

- [ ] Revenue analytics can extract PriorTime using SQL string functions

- [ ] Sample query provided for analytics team

- [ ] Test data demonstrates multi-step roll chain reconstruction

- Regression Testing

- [ ] IAR continues to function normally (no functional changes)

- [ ] Block/roll process still completes successfully

- [ ] New tee times created with correct attributes (rate, rule, etc.)

issues.summary: [Compete] User removed from outing hits an error when Front-end tries to move them into a solo round
issues.description:
When a player is in an Outing round, and they are removed from that round by another player, until recently, they were moved into their own solo outing round and whatever scores they had made were maintained and moved over.

We are now seeing when this process happen, the user hits a graph/scorecard error and they are not put into their own round and just removed from the first round entirely.

We need to see what FK issue is being generated and resolve the error on Scorecard and potentially Graph as well

issues.summary: Add Rate Set Level Granularity for Tee Time Notes
issues.description:
GOAL

Introduce a Tee Time Notes field at the Rate Set level that overrides the existing Facility-level Tee Time Notes setting when populated.

This enhancement enables differentiated messaging by rate set while maintaining backward compatibility with existing functionality.

---
Business Problem

Today, Tee Time Notes can be configured at:

- Tee Time Level (most granular – existing functionality)

- Facility Level (existing functionality)

However, there is no Rate Set level option.

For tee sheet pricing facilities, individual tee times cannot be manually updated. This removes the ability to leverage Tee Time level notes (Priority 1), leaving only a single facility-wide message.

As a result:

- All rate sets inherit the same note.

- Courses cannot differentiate messaging by rate type.

- Tee sheet pricing facilities lack flexibility to manage notes at scale.

Adding a  rate set level override resolves this gap while preserving existing logic.

---
Current State (Must Remain Unchanged)

1. Tee Time–Level Notes (Existing – Highest Priority)

- Configured directly on an individual tee time.

- Overrides all other note levels.

- Must continue to function exactly as it does today.

2.  Facility-Level Notes (Existing – Lowest Priority)

- Configured in Tee Time Settings.

- Applies to all rate sets and tee times unless overridden.

- Must continue to function exactly as it does today.

---
New Functionality

Rate Set–Level Tee Time Notes (Middle prio)

Add a new “Tee Time Notes” text field on the Rate Periods page.

The field must support the same formatting and character limits as the Facility-level Tee Time Notes field

---
Logic / Precedence Rules

The system must follow this hierarchy:

- Tee Time–Level Notes (existing – highest priority)

- Rate Period–Level Notes (NEW)

- Facility-Level Notes (existing – fallback)

Logic Behavior

- If Tee Time–level notes exist → use those.

- Else if Rate Period–level notes are populated → use those.

- Else → use Facility-level notes.

- If Rate Period field is blank/null → default to Facility-level notes.

No changes to the behavior of Tee Time–level or Facility-level notes.

---
Acceptance Criteria

- A new Tee Time Notes field is visible on the Rate Periods page.

- Existing Tee Time–level notes continue to override all other note levels.

- When a Rate Period Tee Time Note is entered:

- It overrides the Facility-level Tee Time Notes.

- It does NOT override Tee Time–level notes.

- It displays anywhere tee time notes are surfaced today.

- When the Rate Period field is blank:

- The system displays Facility-level Tee Time Notes (unless a Tee Time–level note exists).

- Existing facilities without Rate Period notes function exactly as they do today.

- Clearing the Rate Period note reverts behavior to Facility-level (unless Tee Time–level exists).

issues.summary: Mass Cancellation -  Include Trade Toggle Not Working as Intended
issues.description:
The new GNC Mass Cancellation Tool has two issues around facility selection and trade inclusion behavior.

First, the page currently allows mass cancellation behavior while a Master Facility / Trade Facility is selected in the facility dropdown. Mass cancellations should only be available from the play. If a Master Facility is selected, the page should prevent searching/cancelling and display a clear message that mass cancellations are not available for Master Facilities.

Second, when a Play Facility is selected, the Include Trade toggle is not working as expected. Enabling the toggle removes the course rounds from the results and also fails to show the trade rounds. The expected behavior is that the toggle expands the results, not replaces or clears them.

Steps to Reproduce

- Open the GNC Mass Cancellation Tool created under CORE-13954.

- Select a Master Facility / Trade Facility in the facility dropdown.

- Observe that the page still allows the mass cancellation workflow to continue.

- Select a Play Facility that has course rounds in the selected date range.

- Search with Include Trade disabled.

- Confirm course rounds appear.

- Enable Include Trade.

- Search again.

- Observe that course rounds disappear and trade rounds are not shown.

Actual Result

- Master Facilities can be selected and used on the Mass Cancellation page.

- When Include Trade is enabled from a Play Facility, the results no longer show the course rounds.

- Trade rounds are also not returned, leaving the user with missing or incorrect results.

Expected Result

- If a Master Facility / Trade Facility is selected, the Mass Cancellation page should not allow the workflow to continue.

- The UI should show this message:

Mass Cancellations are not available for Master Facilities.

- When a Play Facility is selected:

- Include Trade disabled: show only course rounds within the selected date range.

- Include Trade enabled: show both course rounds and trade rounds within the selected date range together.

Acceptance Criteria

- When the selected facility is a Master Facility / Trade Facility, the page displays:
Mass Cancellations are not available for Master Facilities.

- When a Master Facility / Trade Facility is selected, search and cancellation actions are disabled or otherwise blocked.

- When a Play Facility is selected and Include Trade is disabled, only that facility’s course rounds in the selected date range are returned.

- When a Play Facility is selected and Include Trade is enabled, both course rounds and trade rounds in the selected date range are returned in the same results table.

- Enabling Include Trade must not remove course rounds from the result set.

- If no trade rounds exist for the selected Play Facility/date range, enabling Include Trade should still show the course rounds.

- Results should remain limited to the selected date range in both toggle states.

The new GNC Mass Cancellation Tool has two issues around facility selection and trade inclusion behavior.

First, the page currently allows mass cancellation behavior while a Master Facility / Trade Facility is selected in the facility dropdown. Mass cancellations should only be available from the play. If a Master Facility is selected, the page should prevent searching/cancelling and display a clear message that mass cancellations are not available for Master Facilities.

Second, when a Play Facility is selected, the Include Trade toggle is not working as expected. Enabling the toggle removes the course rounds from the results and also fails to show the trade rounds. The expected behavior is that the toggle expands the results, not replaces or clears them.

Steps to Reproduce

  1. Open the GNC Mass Cancellation Tool created under CORE-13954.

  2. Select a Master Facility / Trade Facility in the facility dropdown.

  3. Observe that the page still allows the mass cancellation workflow to continue.

  4. Select a Play Facility that has course rounds in the selected date range.

  5. Search with Include Trade disabled.

  6. Confirm course rounds appear.

  7. Enable Include Trade.

  8. Search again.

  9. Observe that course rounds disappear and trade rounds are not shown.

Actual Result

  • Master Facilities can be selected and used on the Mass Cancellation page.

  • When Include Trade is enabled from a Play Facility, the results no longer show the course rounds.

  • Trade rounds are also not returned, leaving the user with missing or incorrect results.

Expected Result

  • If a Master Facility / Trade Facility is selected, the Mass Cancellation page should not allow the workflow to continue.

  • The UI should show this message:

Mass Cancellations are not available for Master Facilities.

  • When a Play Facility is selected:

    • Include Trade disabled: show only course rounds within the selected date range.

    • Include Trade enabled: show both course rounds and trade rounds within the selected date range together.

Acceptance Criteria

  1. When the selected facility is a Master Facility / Trade Facility, the page displays:
    Mass Cancellations are not available for Master Facilities.

  2. When a Master Facility / Trade Facility is selected, search and cancellation actions are disabled or otherwise blocked.

  3. When a Play Facility is selected and Include Trade is disabled, only that facility’s course rounds in the selected date range are returned.

  4. When a Play Facility is selected and Include Trade is enabled, both course rounds and trade rounds in the selected date range are returned in the same results table.

  5. Enabling Include Trade must not remove course rounds from the result set.

  6. If no trade rounds exist for the selected Play Facility/date range, enabling Include Trade should still show the course rounds.

  7. Results should remain limited to the selected date range in both toggle states.

issues.summary: Mass Cancellation GNC Page (UI)
issues.description:
Mass Cancellation GNC Page (UI)

Build a Member-Care-facing interface in GNC allowing safe execution of mass cancellations.

Sections for Site:

- Date selector

- API Search Results section

- History Logs of passed Cancellations

---
User Story Block

- As a Member Care agent, I need a page to search reservations by facility and then date range and then perform bulk cancellation with full visibility into results.

---
Mockup

---
SECTION 1: Date Selector

Requirements:

- Add new page: “Mass Cancellation Tool”

- Should be added to the following security groups: (37, 49) NOTE Team users GNC Admin

- Features:

- Facility selector (copies facility selector from other pages)

- Rate Set Drop Down (with All Rate Sets as default option)

- Toggle for IncludeTrade - Even though the facility selected is PlayFacility, if IncludeTrade is toggled, show all trade within the date range selected

- Date range selector (StartDate, EndDate) (copy logic from https://golfnowcentral.com/Reports/Reservations )

SECTION 2: API RESULTS

- “Search” button returning results using API in https://golfnow.atlassian.net/browse/CORE-13945

- Display data from API results in a table that includes:

- ID - Reservation ID (not included in mockup)

- Source

- Customer Name

- Tee Time

- Booked Date

- Players

- Rate Set

- Payment Details

- Tee Time (Link to Tee Time ID page)

- Reservation (Link to Reservation Edit page)

- Each result should have a Checkbox to select individual reservations OR “Select All”

- Button: Cancel Selected

- Opens confirmation modal:

- This should function as a warning as well to inform the user that they are attempting to cancel multiple reservations

- SubmitRefund: yes/no

- The UI should always default to refunding back to original payment method even though the API can choose either. This is in case we need to make a change later, then we only need to add it to the UI.

SECTION 3: History Logs

- Add a section that acts as a sort of Changelog to show the user the past mass cancellations performed for the selected facility.

- Due to the potential massive amount of cancellations, results should be posted into a downloadable CSV file.

- Each mass cancellation result should have its own line item that has the following data:

- Date ranges of cancelled times  → Data range of min and max Reservations submitted play dates

- number of Reservations submitted

- Refunded (Yes or No) - If SubmitRefund was enabled or disabled on Bulk Cancellation API request

- CRMSystemUser.SUUsername of person who made the cancellation. NOTE: pull this from the CRMSystemUser.SystemuserID in the Bulk Cancellation API response

- Date Submitted

- Links to CSV file for download

- CSV file should include:

- ReservationID’s cancelled

- CRMTeeTime.TTDateTime of the ReservationID

- Cancellation status (Cancelled, Failed)

- Error if failed

- Refunded (Yes, No, Failed)

- If Yes, show the following

- Total amount paid

- Total amount refunded

- If no, skip

- If Failed, show the ChargeDetails Error

issues.summary: Bulk Cancellation Endpoint
issues.description:
Create a new endpoint to perform mass cancellations of multiple reservations in a single call, including ability to refund.

Requirements

NOTE: Ensure that all cancellation/refund info is also logged in the database appropriately for CRMTeeTimeReservation and dbo.CanellationRequestLog as we do currently from our cancellation workflow

- Inputs:

- {{ReservationIDs@Ryan Basyooniand decided to leave option as defaulting to always refund to Original Payment Method

- SystemUserID (for tracking) - Log CRMSystemUserID in CRMTeeTimeReservation.ModifiedBy

- Refund logic executes only when SubmitRefund = true.

- Output (per reservation):

- ReservationID

- CancellationStatus

- e.g., Cancelled, Failed, Reserved (Not Cancelled)

- If cancellation fails, provide the Error logged in cancellation endpoint

- TeeSheetRemovalStatus

- Success/Failure

- If failed provide error logged from Tee sheet Service

- CRMChargeDetail.ChargeDetailID's. Support all ChargeDetailID’s attached to reservation (Transaction Fee, Cart Fee, Green Fee etc) - We are NOT going to use each ChargeDetailID as it would be redundant and unnecessary data… instead we will copy the Cancellation Details endpoint and only show the refund amount totals per payment method.

- RefundAmount - Should be the total of all amounts refunded for each payment method

- Refund Location data. This should use the data that is present from the ChargeDetailID that specifies what payment was refunded (CC last four for example)

- Include Payment Processing Errors

- Log Results

- All results should be stored so that we can show the cancellations in the new GNC page https://golfnow.atlassian.net/browse/CORE-13954

- Also ensure that we log the results in Reservation History. This should show in the UI for cancellation history as pictured below. To do this, we will add a new cancellation reason ID called “Mass Cancellation” that is only used for this endpoint.

-

Acceptance Criteria

- Cancels all valid reservations passed into the request.

- Refund logic executes only when SubmitRefund = true.

- Refund is processed to correct location (original payment data is shown).

Ensure that we abide by Nonrefundable amounts. We are NOT going to refund the the NR portions at this time.

Create a new endpoint in Reservation Service designed specifically for bulk retrieval of reservation data or Re-use existing search reservation endpoint from Res Service.  Whichever is optimal for achieving mass cancellations.

Requirements

API call should return all reservations made within the date range that are not fully cancelled. Anything that is any number of remaining players is eligible to be returned in this endpoint. Any fully cancelled reservations should be omitted

- Inputs:

- PlayFacilityID (required)

- StartDate (required)

- EndDate (required)

- ChannelID (optional) - Allow for an array of multiple Channel ID’s - If no ID is provided then it should default to ALL

- TradeOnly (boolean; default = false) (optional - if not provided, default to include both)

- If false, trade times and course times are included.

- If true, trade times are included (only trade).

- Output:

- ReservationID

- TeeTimeID

- GolfCourseID

- Golfer Name

- Player Count

- ChannelID

- Payment Processing Transaction ID

- Basic refund eligibility flags if available NOTE: Get the reservation Metadata flags

- DATE LIMITATION for security

- We need to limit the amount of days that a user can cancel to be 7 days only. I’ll let the dev decide if this means limit this search API to 7 days or there is logic on the cancellation endpoint

- NOTE: Write error message to warn users if more than 7 days are selected

NOTES:

- Discuss with engineering leads on potentially setting Date limitations for performance

Acceptance Criteria

- Returns all reservations within the supplied date range for the facility. (abide by 7 day limitation)

- Optional filtering by ChannelID works as expected.

- TradeOnly correctly includes or excludes course times.

- Response object is optimized for mass-cancellation workflow (minimal, essential fields only).

issues.summary: Create Summary Consumer task for ingesting AI reviews
AI Review Summaries
issues.description:
We will be displaying an AI review summary of the GolfPass reviews of a given facility. The data will come from a new API.

- Design: attached

- The AI Summary object should go right below the star ratings on the Course Details page (attached a reference)

- The only applicable piece of the design is the “AI summaries based on real golfer reviews” header and the two boxes. Do not redesign the stars or anything else on the Course Details page

- API

- URL: GET {{api-base-url}}/GolfNowAPI.svc/rest/facility/review-summaries?golffacilityid=877

Response:

[
{
"BasedOnNumReviews": 25,
"DateOfFirstReviewConsidered": "2024-06-01",
"DateOfLastReviewConsidered": "2024-12-01",
"DateOfSummaryGeneration": "2024-12-08",
"GolfFacilityId": "877",
"SentimentCategory": "courseHighlights",
"SummaryBody": "The course offers a great experience with scenic views and friendly staff."
},
{
"BasedOnNumReviews": 7,
"DateOfFirstReviewConsidered": "2024-06-01",
"DateOfLastReviewConsidered": "2024-12-13",
"DateOfSummaryGeneration": "2024-12-08",
"GolfFacilityId": "877",
"SentimentCategory": "worthNoting",
"SummaryBody": "The course's greens don't roll true."
}
]

- This data will be hardcoded in the API until they can get the db working so this will only work on FacilityIDs 3606, 1806, 877 and 5359

- 3606 - Both categories, short copy

- 1806 - only negative category, short copy

- 877 - both categories, longer copy - Happy Path

- 5359 - no data

- Logic

- Call the above API on page load or pre-load it when you are on the main facility page

- Happy path will be there are two objects in the API with the two sentiment categories

- SentimentCategory

- courseHighlights

- worthNoting

- SummaryBody is the text in the applicable box

- BasedOnNumReviews is the review count in parentheses

- This is flat text, not a link like the design shows

- If only one of the categories returns in the API, display only that applicable box

- If the API returns null, empty, or errors, collapse the space

issues.summary: GolfPass Auto Renewal Save Offer - Database
issues.description:
The D2C team would like to offer an alternate product to a customer if they are attempting disable auto-renew on the front end in an attempt to keep them in a GolfPass subscription but maybe at a discounted price or a lower tier. The front end team would need an API that returns a ProductId, ProductPriceId, ProductTypeId for the best product offer based on the below requirements.

Database Fields

- CurrentProductPriceId

- CancellationReasonId

- OfferedProductPriceId

- IsActive

- LastModifiedBySystemUserId

issues.summary: Enhanced Charity Configuration - Backend
issues.description:
Currently, the front end teams manage various settings related to the charity that should be managed in a centralized location on the backend. We also need to introduce the concept of scheduling charity campaigns to avoid timing releases with DevOps to deploy scripts.

- Add new columns and fields to dbo.Charity and GetCharities API response

- Name: BrandColor

- Value: Whatever supports a hex code like: #FEDB9B

- allow nulls

- Name: BrandLogo

- Value: Whatever supports a url like: https://i8p7v6z9.akamaized.net/content/images/charities/firstteelogo.png

- allow nulls

- Name: IsActive

- Value: Boolean

- GetCharities API response should be updated with these three new fields

- If a Charity has IsActive=False, do not return in the API Response

- Create the concept of scheduling a charity campaign

- Each campaign should have a Campaign Name

- This will not need to return in the API but will be used in the GNC UI

- This is a unique field and cannot match other entries

- GetCharities request should always assume the current date/time is of the local timezone of the golf course

- There will never be a scenario where we want to call the GetCharities API for a future date or date range

- A user should be able to configure a charity to be active on specified date/times

- If no Start time provided, Start Time should always be 12:01am local time of the golf course

- if no End time provided, End Time should always be 11:59pm local time of the golf course

- If current Date/Time is within the date range, GetCharities API should return the scheduled charity

- If current Date/Time is outside of the date range, GetCharities API should not return that charity

- If StartDate and EndDate of a campaign are NULL, that means the campaign is applicable at any time

- If EndDate of a campaign is NULL, that means the campaign is applicable any time after the StartDate

- If StartDate of a campaign IS NULL, that means the campaign is applicable any time before the EndDate

- A user should be able to configure multiple charities to be active at the same time at the same applicable area/regions

- Expect that both charities would return in GetCharities response

- If a user does not want overlapping charities, the expectation would be that the EndDate would need to be updated and then a new entry with new start/end date would be created (similar to AutoLoads)

- A user should be able to schedule a single charity in one set of areas/regions and then the same charity for a different set of areas/regions for a different time period

- All of the above will be exposed on a new Charity Configuration page in GNC https://golfnow.atlassian.net/browse/CORE-12008

issues.summary: GolfPass Auto Renewal Save Offer - API
issues.description:
The D2C team would like to offer an alternate product to a customer if they are attempting disable auto-renew on the front end in an attempt to keep them in a GolfPass subscription but maybe at a discounted price or a lower tier. The front end team would need an API that returns a ProductId, ProductPriceId, ProductTypeId for the best product offer based on the below requirements.

- Potential Request Example: GET /subscription/{CUSTOMERSUBSCRIPTIONID}/renewal-product-offer?cancellationReasonId={CANCELLATIONREASONID}

- Response Example:

- [{
"ProductTypeId":9,
"ProductId": 36,
"ProductPriceId": 655
}]

The API would return the mapped product info based on the current PPID of the customer and cancellation reason of the subscription (provided by client). So we would need a database mapping of Current ProductPriceId → Cancellation Reason → Product Offer

- The API will use the CustomerSubscriptionId to get the current PPID

- DB mapping is from https://golfnow.atlassian.net/browse/CORE-14068

- Example: CurrentProductPriceId=64 → CancellationReason=Too Expensive → ProductOffer=9,36,655

- If there is no mapping found for the PPID of the customer, return an empty array []

- CancellationReasonId should not be a required field in the API call

- If the client does not pass in a CancellationReasonId, it would look for the record in the database that has CancellationReasonId IS NULL for the PPID that matches the CustomerSubscriptionId

comments.author: Andrew Horvat
comments.body:
QA Testing

You need to call /GET GolfNowAPI.svc/rest/subscription/{CUSTOMERSUBSCRIPTIONID}/renewal-product-offer?cancellationReasonId={CANCELLATIONREASONID} with subscription ID and cancellation reason ID. You will need to use the document located here to determine what values you should get back from the endpoint.

Here’s the table that holds all the mapping data: [CRM].[Product].[RenewalProductOffer]

Here’s the the logic from the stored procedure to see the tables involved:

SELECT RPO.OfferedProductPriceId AS ProductPriceID,
PR.ProductID,
PR.ProductTypeID
FROM Product.RenewalProductOffer RPO
INNER JOIN Product.Purchase PU
ON RPO.CurrentProductPriceId = PU.ProductPriceID
INNER JOIN Product.ProductPricing PP
ON RPO.OfferedProductPriceId = PP.ProductPriceID
INNER JOIN Product.Product PR
ON PP.ProductID = PR.ProductID
WHERE PU.CustomerSubscriptionID = 224104
AND (RPO.CancellationReasonId = 5
OR (RPO.CancellationReasonId IS NULL AND 5 IS NULL))
AND RPO.IsActive = 1;

issues.summary: Add auto round up and state validations to charities
issues.description:
To comply with state laws, we will no longer be able to automatically select the Round Up charity option when they land on checkout. This is currently managed by the UI teams. With the additional requirement of this being a state by state configuration, we would like the backend to determine whether auto round up is eligible.

- Add a new column to dbo.charity

- Name: IsAutoRoundUp

- Value: boolean

- Insert TRUE for all charities upon prod release

- Add the ability to disable the IsAutoRoundUp by a State/Province blacklist

- Table with Country and StateProv keys, and a AutoRoundUpDisabled field, with create/update timestamps.

- Country and StateProv should be primary clustered key, StateProv should be nullable to allow for a default override at country level if no matching StateProv is found.

- Insert California and New York upon prod release

- Update GetCharities API

- URL: https://rc2-api.gnsvc.com/GolfNowAPI.svc/rest/channel/{CHANNELID}/charities?facilityid={FACILITYID}

- Add IsAutoRoundUp boolean to the response for each charity record

- State/Prov Validations:

- If you call GetCharities with a FacilityId located in California

- IsAutoRoundUp=false

- If you call GetCharities with a FacilityId located in Texas

- IsAutoRoundUp=true

- If a specific charity is already set up to IsAutoRoundUp=false, calling GetCharities in California should remain IsAutoRoundUp=false

issues.summary: Add OwnerID Validation Back to Ancillary.CharitySelet Sproc
issues.description:
As part of https://golfnow.atlassian.net/browse/CORE-12946, the OwnerID validation was removed from the [Ancillary].[CharitySelect] stored procedure. We are now seeing problems with the apps displaying charities despite the specific OwnerID not being enabled for those charities. To fix this, we need to add the OwnerID validation back to the stored procedure.

Example 1: OwnerID 21201 is not configured for any charities in dbo.CRMOwnerCharity, but the API returns charityIDs 1, 2, and 5.

Example 2: OwnerID 331 is only configured for charityIDs 2 and 5, but the API is returning charityID 1.

OwnerID Validation Clause:

WHERE [oc].[OwnerID] = @OwnerID
AND
(
[oc].[GolfFacilityID] = @PlayFacilityID
OR [gfh].[GolfFacilityHierarchyID] IS NOT NULL
)

Acceptance Criteria:

- The OwnerID is configured for a specific charity or charities

- When the OwnerID validation clause is added back to the Ancillary.CharitySelect sproc, the sproc will return the same charity configurations set up in dbo.CRMCharityOwner for that specific owner

- The API will also return the same configurations set up in dbo.CRMCharityOwner for that specific owner

issues.summary: Surface IsWaivable and IsRefundable through the FeeConfiguration data access layer
issues.description:
Summary

CORE-14444 added IsWaivable and IsRefundable columns to Revenue.FeeConfiguration at the database level, but intentionally deferred the application-layer integration. This ticket connects those columns through the data access layer so they are available to downstream business logic (waiver decisions, refund calculations) in future tickets.

This is a data plumbing ticket — it makes the values available in-memory but does NOT change any business behavior. No customer-facing impact until future tickets consume these properties behind LaunchDarkly.

---
What This Connects To

These columns enable the Customizable Transaction Fees epic (CORE-13901) to support fees with different behaviors:

- IsWaivable — Determines whether a GolfPass waived-fee-credit can be applied to this fee. Standard convenience fees are waivable; tourism/regulatory fees are not.

- IsRefundable — Determines whether this fee is included in refund calculations on cancellation. Standard fees are refundable; certain regulatory fees are not.

Downstream consumers (future tickets, not this one):

- GolfPass waiver logic in Reservation Service (LoyaltyHelper)

- Refund/cancellation workflow in Reservation Service (BuildRefundInvoiceActivity)

- Admin UI in RMS for setting these values per fee configuration

---
Areas Touched

- Stored Procedure — Revenue.GetFeeConfigurationByOwnerFacilityCourse needs to include IsWaivable and IsRefundable in its CTE and final SELECT output

- Framework DTO — GolfNow.Framework.Pricing.Fees.Data.DTO.FeeConfiguration needs corresponding boolean properties

- Sequencing — The GNDS stored procedure update should deploy before or simultaneously with the code change. DTO properties should default to true as a safety net during rolling deploys.

---
What This Does NOT Touch

- No behavior changes — this is purely making data available

- No admin UI changes (RMS models, GolfCourse Service models — separate future ticket)

- No waiver logic changes

- No refund logic changes

- No other stored procedures need updating for this ticket (other sprocs that read/write FeeConfiguration don't need these columns yet — INSERT operations are protected by DEFAULT constraints, UPDATE operations don't touch these columns)

---
Technical Reference

A detailed investigation document is attached covering:

Please be sure to do your own investigation of course

- Full stored procedure analysis (all 6 sprocs that touch the table)

- Complete data flow diagram (DB → DAL → Provider → Consumer)

- Caching assessment (confirmed: no caching on this path)

- All FeeConfiguration model locations across the codebase

- Risk assessment and sequencing considerations

- Downstream consumer mapping for future tickets

---
Acceptance Criteria

- The booking flow's fee configuration data includes IsWaivable and IsRefundable values from the database

- Existing behavior is preserved — all current fees return true for both properties (matching the database defaults)

- No customer-facing behavior changes

- DTO property defaults ensure safe behavior during rolling deploys (default to true if column not present)

---
Related

- CORE-14444 — Database columns (prerequisite, CLOSED)

- CORE-13901 — Parent epic

- CORE-14332 — LaunchDarkly gating (foundation, CLOSED)

- CORE-14117 — Fee messaging moved to post-calculation (foundation, CLOSED)
