issues.summary: Restrict USGA account linking if GN user and USGA user have different genders
issues.description:
Summary: {Describe the issue and provide any relevant context}

Currently both our Golfnow/Compete account and the USGA account have independent gender values, each stored in independent systems. This is allowing a Male Golfnow user to link to a Female USGA user or vice versa. When this occurs, Compete defaults to the tee selection of the Golfnow user, and once that round is scored and posted to USGA, and error is thrown for incompatible tees to the USGA gender.

Steps to Reproduce: {If applicable, list the steps to reproduce the described issue in a clear and concise bulleted list}

- Login as a Male Golfnow user/or create a new Male Golfnow user account in compete

- navigate to the USGA linking flow and link this Male Golfnow user to a Female USGA account - This is where the new validation needs to be implemented

- confirm through email the link to establish this connection

- once the accounts are linked, open the play tab on compete and score any casual round on a USGA course with the tees provided through regular casual round setup

- after finishing the round attempt to push your score to USGA for handicaping purposes

Expected Results: {What is the expected or correct behavior?}

- We would expect this linkage to be prevented earlier in the flow, only same gendered accounts can be linked, or at the very least be able to push scores to the USGA

Actual Results: {What is the observed behavior?}

- currently we are getting an error when trying to push a score to the USGA from tees that do not match the USGA user gender.

“errorMessage”: “The golfer’s gender should match with the tee set gender”,

issues.description:
The UI teams will be required to display the billing start date in the T&Cs and we need a data point on the invoice to display this.

- Logic:

- If a ProductPriceId (PPID) is tagged as IsTrial=True

- Example: If SubscriptionStart = 8/22/2024 and EndDate = 8/29/2024, BillingStartDate=8/30/2024

- If a PPID is not tagged as IsTrial

- Return today’s date if you do not have an active membership

- If I have an active annual subscription with an EndDate of 12/31/2025, if im trying to purchase another annual subscription ahead of time on 9/9/2025, i would expect this value to = 1/1/2026

issues.summary: Propagate Facility Merchant Key Updates from GNC to Commerce
issues.description:
When a facility’s merchant key is updated in GNC (full-stack update), the change is not currently communicated to Commerce.

As a result, Commerce may continue using an outdated merchant key, which can lead to inconsistencies between systems and potential downstream issues during payment processing.

Desired Outcome

Ensure that whenever a facility’s merchant key is updated in GNC, the updated key is sent to Commerce using the endpoint provided by the Commerce team.

This allows Commerce to stay in sync with the latest facility merchant configuration and ensures accurate payment handling.

Scope

- Detect full-stack facility merchant key updates in GNC

- Invoke the Commerce-provided endpoint with the updated merchant key

- Ensure Commerce receives and applies the updated value

issues.descriptionHtml:
:question: What’s the issue:

There is potential for Gender mismatch between a USGA (provider) account and the API 2.1 profile gender. This creates issues in Tee Selection and other gender-related features.

This is an issue for checking Gender for golfers included on the end-users round, not the end-user themselves.

Front-end needs to know the provider (USGA) gender for scoring purposes so we can be sure there’s no mismatch

:check_mark: Acceptance Criteria

  1. Need to send back USGA gender rather than GN gender for users that are linked in PlayerRound Object. Backend is sending us gender using playerGender. Backend should send us USGA gender in playerGender or backend can make a new field.

issues.summary: state parameter on the Golfer Search endpoint isn't filtering results

:check_mark:  Acceptance Criteria

the Graph endpoint for searching USGA users

GET https://rc2-graph.gnsvc.com/api/v2/:provider/golfer/search

has a state parameter to pass on the endpoint. However if you pass a certain state you get results with blank value - “ “ - or results with Null or incorrect values. Need to look into this parameter and field and see how it can be better utilized to return appropriate results

screen shows below is a filter with lastName and state, users returned have blank and incorrect state values compared to the CT that was passed with last name Collins.

issues.summary: 9-hole scores are not posting properly to USGA for specific tee sets
issues.description:
- use a Compete user that is linked to the USGA

- boot up a round and select Lower Baltusrol Golf Club

- select Back 9 and select the III/II tee set

- score just the back nine (holes 10-18)

- save the round

- try and submit the round to USGA

More information about this issue:

- the USGA course data looks fine for active tee sets of that title, for males and females--there is a tee set for each of them with same name, so I’m curious what the record looks like in our DB and whether a mapping exists at all

- there are two TeeSets for Males of that name, and one is inactive--so we may have a broken tee set mapping

- posting a back 9 score at other courses is working fine for the same user (I did Bloomington Country Club back 9 and it posted)

issues.summary: Save an 18-hole total scorecard
issues.description:
:book:  User Story

Golfers must have the option (per USGA) to post “total” scores. These scores can be done at a 9-hole or 18-hole total. It is the quickest way to take a scorecard and submit a valid score to the handicapping provider.

:check_mark:  Acceptance Criteria

- golfer selects a course

- golfer selects a tee set for the course

- we now have the course rating and slope information for the given course and tee set

- golfer selects equivalent of “post a quick score”

- golfer selects from:

- post 9-hole score (front 9 or back 9)

- post 18 hole score using 9 & 9

- post 18 hole score total

- golfer is presented with a new view that summarizes the course data they are posting to and is given prompts for keypad entry for the scoring

- golfer taps into 18-hole single input and can enter any value using the keypad

- golfer inputs the gross score of 85

- golfer will always input gross score

- golfer is presented option to Post Score to (provider) because there is a valid input of 85

- golfer selects the Post Score option

- the score is posted for the course, tee set and gross score to the provider

- the score is saved to their Round History

- front-end will need to present a response from the API as to whether the score was posted successfully to provider (if applicable) AND saved to their Compete account

- this can be done using our standard solo score confirmation view but we’ll need to incorporate the course rating and slope info

🔖  Please link Swagger and/or other documentation created as part of this effort

Link:

This ensures the front-end is armed with information they need for linked dependencies.

issues.summary: Improve Fulfillment Validations for Component and Related Fee Items
issues.description:
Refactored both PrepareFulfillment and ExecuteFulfillment endpoints to enforce stricter and more consistent validation rules for invoice components and related fee items before processing. These changes improve safety, traceability, and maintainability by aligning behavior across both fulfillment stages.

Key Changes:

- Added validation to ensure each item has at least one component.

- Ensured all components and related fees have non-null, non-whitespace InventorySource.Key values.

- Added case-insensitive duplicate key detection for both components and related fees.

- Verified that all expected components and related fees from the invoice are present in the request.

- Verified that no unexpected components or related fees are present in the request.

- Validated that prices in the request match the invoice expectations for all matched components and related fees.

These changes help ensure invoice integrity, improve error messaging, and avoid incomplete or mismatched fulfillment requests to the GolfNow platform.

issues.summary: Add Special Handling for BRSG ConfirmationNumber When Setting TeeSheetBookingId
issues.description:
Updated logic for setting the TeeSheetBookingId metadata value based on tee sheet configuration:

- For BRSG tee sheets, the ConfirmationNumber is expected to be in the format "LAST_NAME|BOOKING_ID". The code now extracts and uses only the booking ID portion as the TeeSheetBookingId.

- For all other tee sheet types, the full ConfirmationNumber continues to be used as-is.

- If no tee sheet configuration is found, the system defaults to using the full ConfirmationNumber.

This change ensures downstream consumers receive a clean booking ID when working with BRSG tee sheets.

issues.summary: Points for Actions Rules Engine for Event Consumer
issues.description:
We need a mechanism to configure specific types of actions and rules to deliver Loyalty points.

- Action Segment

- Bookings

- Renewal

- Product purchase

- Profile

- Conditional

- Quantity of bookings

- Renewal success

- Membership start

- Field insert

- Account creation

- Attributes

- Reservation type

- Hot Deal

- Course

- Within time period

- Number of days

- Custom date range

- Start Date should start at 00:00:00

- End Date should end at 23:59:00

- Number of weeks

- Number of months

- Number of years

- Time of day

- Days out

- Today = Day 0

- Day of week

- Reservation quantity

- Award logic

- Booking should be applied after Xth booking play date

- Only award points as long as one player is still available/booked for reservation

- We will need to hardcode a look back date of January 1, 2024

- Examples:

- Scenario:

- I have 100 reservations before 2024

- I have greater than or equal to 2 reservations after 2024

- I will not receive points when i book again in 2025

- Scenario:

- I have 100 reservations before 2024

- I have 1 reservation after 2024

- I will receive points when i book next in 2025

- Scenario:

- I have 0 reservations before 2024

- I have 0 reservation after 2024

- I will receive points when i book the 2nd reservation in 2025

- Cancellation logic

- Pre play date: No points are awarded

- Post play date: If one of the qualifying reservations is fully cancelled, this would deduct all points

- Round quantity

- Award logic

- Booking should be applied after Xth booking play date

- Only award points as long as all players who are qualified for the campaign are still available/booked for reservation

- Cancellation logic

- Pre play date: No points are awarded

- Ex: I need to book 4 rounds in one month to qualify. If I cancel down to 3 players, do not award the points

- Post play date: If one of the qualifying rounds is cancelled, this would deduct all points

- Ex: I need to book 4 rounds in one month to qualify. If I cancel down to 3 players, deduct the points

- Membership type

- ProductID

- ProductPriceID

- ProductTypeID

- IsTrial

- IsComplimentary

- Membership status

- Active

- Facility

- Specific FIDs

- IsSimulator

- Channel

- Specific channel IDs

- Common fields

- Phone number

- Birthdate

- City

- State

- Country

- Zip

- Wallet (gift card)

- Preferred language

- Max use per customer

- Max use per campaign

Note: The combination of restrictions should be an AND statement (examples below)

Example 1:

- Loyalty.Action.ActionId = 2

- Loyalty.Action.Action = Second booking reward

- Loyalty.Action.Description = Book two reservations within a 7-day period, receive X points.

- Action Segment = Bookings

- Conditional = Quantity of bookings

- Attributes

- Reservation type

- Reservation type value = Hot Deal

- Within time period

- Time period value = 7 days

- Reservation quantity

- Reservation quantity value = 2

Example 2:

- Loyalty.Action.ActionId = 3

- Loyalty.Action.Action = Add phone number

- Loyalty.Action.Description = Add phone number to profile, receive X points.

- Action Segment = Profile

- Conditional = Field insert

- Attributes

- Common field

- Common field value = Phone number

issues.summary: Add Support for ClientToken Header to API 2.1

comments.author: Tyler Olechnowicz
comments.body:
QA

Please test the following:

- Generate a new client token via the Commerce Proxy API (see https://golfnow.atlassian.net/browse/CORE-13460).

- Supply this client token to an API 2.1 endpoint (OrderCheckoutInvoice for example) via the ClientToken header.

- You must create the token with a valid username/password, otherwise you will get errors. Please validate this.

- The ChannelId that the token was created with must match the one in the request, otherwise you will get an error. Please validate this.

- If ClientToken is valid, the API request should go through and you should get a successful response. Please validate this.

NOTE - CLIENT TOKEN EXPIRES AFTER 30-32 MINUTES.

issues.summary: Add SendToTeeSheetPOS metadata flag to control G1 POS order creation
issues.description:
The Commerce Proxy API has been updated to include a new metadata flag, SendToTeeSheetPOS, which controls whether G1 creates a POS order for a tee time.

This flag is determined based on the SEND_ORDER_TO_INTERFACE golf course setting and the amount due at the course. The logic is as follows:

- If SEND_ORDER_TO_INTERFACE is "0", set SendToTeeSheetPOS to false

- If SEND_ORDER_TO_INTERFACE is "1" and DueAtCourseAmount is greater than 0, set to false

- If SEND_ORDER_TO_INTERFACE is "1" and DueAtCourseAmount is 0 or less, set to true

The flag is stored in the item's metadata and passed to the Commerce API, which in turn passes it to G1 for downstream POS integration.

comments.author: Tyler Olechnowicz
comments.body:
QA Instructions

- Endpoint to Test:
POST https://commerceproxy.internal.main/api/invoice/create
Make sure to point this request to your designated testing environment.

- What to Verify:

- In the API response, inspect each item's metadata.

- Confirm the presence and value of the SendToTeeSheetPOS metadata field.

- Test Scenarios:

- SEND_ORDER_TO_INTERFACE = "1" and DueAtCourseAmount = 0
Expect: SendToTeeSheetPOS = true

- SEND_ORDER_TO_INTERFACE = "1" and DueAtCourseAmount > 0
Expect: SendToTeeSheetPOS = false

- SEND_ORDER_TO_INTERFACE = "0" or missing
Expect: SendToTeeSheetPOS = false

- Setup Notes:

- You can modify the SEND_ORDER_TO_INTERFACE setting using the Interface Configuration UI in GNC.

- Navigate to:
GNC > Interface Configuration
Select the desired facility, then toggle the Send Order To Interface switch under the "Interface Config." tab.

- Ensure the test tee time ID you use maps to a GolfCourseID with the appropriate setting in dbo.CRMGolfCourseSettings.

issues.summary: Timelyst - Venue to Offering refactor
issues.description:
## Overview
Major domain model refactoring to rename Venue to Offering and restructure Facility to represent physical locations.

## Status: Not Started

## Objectives
1. Rename Venue entity to Offering throughout the codebase
2. Move location-specific properties from Venue/Offering to Facility
3. Establish Facility as the physical location entity
4. Establish Offering as categories/types of offerings within a facility

## Architecture Changes

### Before:
```
Facility (grouping only)
└── Venue (physical location + offering type)
├── Address
├── Amenities
├── OperatingHours
├── TimeZone
└── Resources
```

### After:
```
Facility (physical location)
├── Address
├── Amenities
├── OperatingHours
├── TimeZone
└── Offering (category/type)
└── Resources
```

issues.summary: Timelyst - Discovery Schema Consolidation
issues.description:
Overview
Implement and complete the FacilityDiscovery and ServiceAvailabilitySnapshot data schemas as read-only MongoDB collections optimized for client search and availability queries. These collections will serve as pre-computed, denormalized views that provide fast, efficient access to facility search results and service availability information.

Business Requirements

FacilityDiscovery Collection
- Purpose: Enable fast, lightweight facility search with basic offering information
- Use Case: Client applications searching for facilities by location, name, or attributes

ServiceAvailabilitySnapshot Collection
- Purpose: Provide pre-computed availability and pricing for all services at a facility
- Use Case: Client applications viewing service availability for date ranges

Data Flow Architecture
```
Source Collections (Write)          Discovery Collections (Read-Only)
┌───────────────────┐               ┌───────────────────────┐
│    Facility      │               │  FacilityDiscovery  │
│    Offering      │───────────────►│  (Denormalized)     │
│    Service       │  Queue/Batch  │                     │
│    Resource      │  Processing   └──────────────────────┘
│    RateSet       │
└───────────────────┘                ┌───────────────────────────────┐
│ ServiceAvailabilitySnapshot│
┌──────────────────────┐             │ (Pre-computed by           │
│ResourceAvailability│─────────────►│  Offering+Service+Date)    │
└──────────────────────┘             └──────────────────────────────┘
```

issues.summary: Timelyst - Facility Geosearch endpoint #1
issues.description:
Enable clients to search for facilities using text search, geospatial coordinates, and product vertical type filtering with MongoDB Atlas Search integration. The implementation provides ultra-lightweight facility search responses optimized for mobile and web clients.

Project Requirements
- MongoDB Atlas Search integration with `FacilityDiscovery_Search_Index`
- Text search with autocomplete on facility names
- Geospatial search using latitude/longitude coordinates
- Product vertical type filtering

# Text search only
GET /api/v1/client/search/facilities?q=golf

# Geospatial search
GET /api/v1/client/search/facilities?lat=36.5674&long=-121.9522

# Combined search with filters
GET /api/v1/client/search/facilities?q=premier&lat=36.5674&long=-121.9522&productVerticalType=1

- MongoDB Atlas Search integration with `FacilityDiscovery_Search_Index`
- Text search with autocomplete on facility names
- Geospatial search using latitude/longitude coordinates
- Product vertical type filtering

# Text search only
GET /api/v1/client/search/facilities?q=golf

# Geospatial search
GET /api/v1/client/search/facilities?lat=36.5674&long=-121.9522

# Combined search with filters
GET /api/v1/client/search/facilities?q=premier&lat=36.5674&long=-121.9522&productVerticalType=1

issues.summary: Timelyst - GetFacilitySummary endpoint #2
issues.description:
Overview

Create a new search endpoint that returns detailed facility information with availability snapshots for a specific date, filtered by location, channel, and product vertical type. This endpoint provides a focused view of available facilities with their relevant offerings and pricing for a given date.

Requirements

- Date-specific availability filtering

- Channel-based RateSet filtering

- ProductVerticalType matching at offering level

- Geospatial search with score threshold

- Filtered response structure maintaining hierarchy

API Endpoint

- Path: `/api/v1/client/search/facilities/detail`

- Method: GET

- Query Parameters:

- `date` (required): Target date for availability (format: YYYY-MM-DD)

- `latitude` (required): Search center latitude (-90 to 90)

- `longitude` (required): Search center longitude (-180 to 180)

- `channelId` (required): Channel identifier for RateSet filtering

- `productVerticalType` (required): Product vertical type enum value

- `distanceMiles` (optional): Search radius in miles (default: 35, max: 500)

- `minPrice` (optional): Minimum price filter (decimal, default: null)

- `maxPrice` (optional): Maximum price filter (decimal, default: null)

- `firstTimeSlot` (optional): First time slot filter (TimeSpan, format: HH:mm, default: null)

- `lastTimeSlot` (optional): Last time slot filter (TimeSpan, format: HH:mm, default: null)

- `limit` (optional): Results per page (default: 20, max: 100)

- `offset` (optional): Pagination offset (default: 0)

issues.summary: Timelyst - Standardization & Optimization
issues.description:
Requirements

- Standardize all API endpoints to return `PagedCollection<T>` for consistent response structure across the entire API surface. This ensures uniform pagination metadata, HATEOAS link support, and predictable response structure for API consumers.

- Remove unused classes/DTOs and code cleanup.

- Identify and resolve N+1 query anti-pattern

- Make sure transaction support for multi-document updates

issues.summary: Timelyst - Queue & Trigger
issues.description:
Create two new admin endpoint in that accepts a queue ID, finds the queue item, and processes it by calling the either RebuildFacilityDiscoveryAsync or RebuildServiceAvailabilitySnapshotAsync function.

The goal is to setup a Mongo change stream monitoring on the two Queue collections and on Insert/Update with the Status : Pending, the change stream monitoring application will trigger a API call to the two admin endpoints to process the rebuild for client side data.

issues.summary: Timelyst - Add booking endpoints & logics
issues.description:
Requirements:

- Accept a FacilityId + OfferingId + ServiceId + ChannelId + StartTime + UserId.

- Update a Resource’s Availability and insert a new BookingInfo

- Call out to third party API (club champion) to make the booking

- success or failure will pass back to the OrderProcessing API.

- Will be provided UserInfo from upstream.

- Call to OrderProcessing API and get a purchase information.

Look into TeeSheet Service (similar flow)

issues.summary: Defer cached invoice removal until after fulfillment completes to prevent missing cache errors for duplicate items
issues.description:
During fulfillment, multiple identical items can share the same cached invoice key.
Previously, the cache entry was deleted immediately after each item was processed, which caused subsequent items referencing the same key to fail with a “Cached invoice data is missing” error.

This update modifies the logic to:

- Track all unique OrderInvoiceResponseCacheKey values in a HashSet

- Defer cache removal until the entire fulfillment process completes successfully

- Skip deletion on failure to allow retries until the cache naturally expires (TTL: 60 minutes)

Outcome:
Prevents missing-cache errors when duplicate items exist in the same request and ensures consistent cleanup once all fulfillments succeed.

comments.author: Yu-Sheng Tu
comments.body:
- Why if you search for a city and then add a space it alters results from what they were before space addition?

{{GEOSEARCH.API.URL}}/v1/geoplaces/lookup?lat=28.48&long=-81.56&take=1000&q=las vegas

there is a condition in the search aggregation to add additional score if the full name of the record, ie "Las Vegas" in this case, match exactly (including any spacing). So in the case of las vegas , it fail to match and apply the score, hence reducing the score of the "Las Vegas" record.

The fix is to do a Trim off any whitespace before passing through the search engine

comments.author: Tyler Olechnowicz
comments.body:
QA Testing Instructions – ValidateItem Endpoint

Please follow the steps below to validate the behavior of the ValidateItem endpoint:

- Generate a Client Token:

- Call the GenerateClientToken endpoint to obtain a fresh client-token header for authentication.

- Call the ValidateItem Endpoint:

- Use the ValidateItem endpoint to validate a tee time entry in the cart.

- Set the Correct Fulfillment Source Name:

- For course times, set Source.Name to "gn-course-time".

- For trade times, set Source.Name to "gn-trade-time".

- Validation Performed by Endpoint:

- Confirms that a valid tee time ID was supplied.

- Ensures that the tee time exists in the system.

- Verifies that the requested Quantity is allowed based on the tee time’s player rule (e.g., minimum and maximum number of players).

- Verify the Response:

- If all validations pass, the response should include IsExecutionSuccessful = true.

- If any validation fails, the response should include IsExecutionSuccessful = false and a FailureReason describing the issue.

- Validate Selectable Players:

- The response includes a list of selectable players for the tee time.

- Ensure this list aligns with the player rule associated with the tee time (e.g., correct number of player slots allowed).

comments.author: Lara Golovachenko
comments.body:
Seems like main issue was resolved here. However, the remaining issue with polluted/irrelevant results is still happening. We may need to trim those results.

Example: {{GEOSEARCH.API.URL}}/v1/geoplaces/lookup?lat=28.493886&long=-81.603524&take=30&q=saddle = 6 results, all relevant.

{{GEOSEARCH.API.URL}}/v1/geoplaces/lookup?lat=28.493886&long=-81.603524&take=30&q=saddle c - correct first result is given Saddle Creek Golf Club but now results pool is increased to 48 (courses), adding all “nearby” facilities with low score past result #6. Research ticket created https://golfnow.atlassian.net/browse/CORE-13337

There is still some cases in which this logic may have some flaws, noted it in https://golfnow.atlassian.net/browse/CORE-13261

(Example: {{GEOSEARCH.API.URL}}/v1/geoplaces/lookup?lat=28.493886&long=-81.603524&take=30&q=painted gives two results Painted Mountain Golf Club (DEV)(8.881924629211426) and Painted Desert Golf Club (DEV)(8.878491401672363), where after {{GEOSEARCH.API.URL}}/v1/geoplaces/lookup?lat=28.493886&long=-81.603524&take=30&q=painted d search we get Painted Desert Golf Club (DEV)( with 18.818376541137695 score)but then Painted Mountain Golf Club (DEV)comes up with 9.220947265625 score, why? Also that second search now returns bunch of irrelevant other results with low rankings. May need to create another ticket to remove low ranking results or do not return irrelevant results at all.)

RE-TEST AFTER https://golfnow.atlassian.net/browse/CORE-13337 is fixed

issues.summary: Add BreakOutFees Property to Support Fee Breakdown in API 2.1 OrderCheckoutInvoice Response
issues.description: Reservation Service currently supports a BreakoutFees property in the GetReservationInvoice endpoint. This property makes the endpoint include Cart Fee in the due online items breakdown instead of rolling Cart Fee into the Greens Fee line item. We need to add a flag to the API 2.1 OrderCheckoutInvoice request that we can pass down to reservation service to force this fee breakout.

comments.author: Tyler Olechnowicz
comments.body:
QA

Please test the following:

- Test the new BreakOutFees property in the API 2.1 OrderCheckoutInvoice endpoint. This is a boolean true/false property. issues.summary: GNC - Create T&Cs Management Page
issues.description:
We need to create a page in GNC that will allow Legal to update the Terms & Conditions templates themselves, rather than waiting on scripts to be run through DS.

Requirements:

Product Terms & Conditions

- This will be a new tab under GNC Administration

- Page should contain the following

- ‘New Template’ button

- This will redirect users to the second page (below) - Edit Product Terms & Conditions

- Display filter where users can choose to view templates by specific statuses

- Active

- Inactive

- All

- Template ID

- Template Name

- Status

- Action

- Edit

- Redirects the user to the specific template in the Edit Product Terms & Conditions page where they can edit:

- Template Name

- Is Active

- Template Body

- Copy

- Redirects the user to the Edit Product Terms & Conditions page prefilled with the information specific to the copied template where they can edit:

- Template Name

- Is Active

- Template Body

- Template ID will create itself upon saving

- Disable

- Updates the UI and database status of the template to ‘Inactive’

- Add a ‘New Template’ button

Edit Product Terms & Conditions

- Creating a new template will redirect the user to a second page called Edit Product Terms & Conditions

- This page should populate the following fields:

- Template Name

- Blank box for users to write in the template name

- Is Active?

- Checkbox - Default to unchecked

- Template body

- Markdown editor plugin with user friendly formatting header (example - https://ui.toast.com/tui-editor )

- Template ID will create itself upon saving

- Creating a new template will write the new template information into the database - https://golfnow.atlassian.net/browse/CORE-13302?atlOrigin=eyJpIjoiYjlkYjNjMGFhMzFmNDk2M2JhY2M4YWQ2YzJjZDBkMjgiLCJwIjoiaiJ9

- Template ID

- Template Name

- Status

Permissions

- Add a new permission to the GNC Security Group Exceptions called - Manage Product Terms & Conditions

- With this permission, you have Read/Write access to all aspects of the page

- If you only have Super Admin and do not have the Manage Product Terms & Conditions checkbox, then you should only be able to Read/View the information

- New Template button should be removed

- Edit, Disable and Copy should be removed

- New Product Terms & Conditions tab under GNC Administration should not be visible to any user outside of the Super Admin group

issues.summary: Remove $type from API responses and normalize Metadata for cross-platform consumption
issues.description:
Eliminate Newtonsoft $type annotations from API responses and standardize the Metadata field to a plain, cross-platform JSON object (primitives, dictionaries, lists).

Changes

- Configure JSON serialization:

- TypeNameHandling = None to prevent emitting/consuming $type.

- SerializationBinder = null to ensure no custom binder is used.

- MetadataHelper:

- Normalize incoming metadata to Dictionary<string, object?> with case-insensitive keys.

- Recursively coerce values to primitives/dictionaries/lists.

Outcome

- API responses no longer include $type, improving interoperability for non-.NET clients (e.g., Node).

- Metadata preserves intended structure and scalar values.

- Safer, clearer JSON contract across endpoints.
issues.descriptionHtml:
Eliminate Newtonsoft $type annotations from API responses and standardize the Metadata field to a plain, cross-platform JSON object (primitives, dictionaries, lists).

Changes

  • Configure JSON serialization:

    • TypeNameHandling = None to prevent emitting/consuming $type.

    • SerializationBinder = null to ensure no custom binder is used.

  • MetadataHelper:

    • Normalize incoming metadata to Dictionary<string, object?> with case-insensitive keys.

    • Recursively coerce values to primitives/dictionaries/lists.

Outcome

  • API responses no longer include $type, improving interoperability for non-.NET clients (e.g., Node).

  • Metadata preserves intended structure and scalar values.

  • Safer, clearer JSON contract across endpoints.

issues.summary: Proximity weight addition fine tuning
issues.description:
Proximity weight to the total score was added in general but for some cases that does not seems to be enough. I see weight changing when location was changed but the results array is not, it stayed the same. It appears that if proximity is less than about 1-5  mies it will alter the result in the closest location being on top, but if proximity is already about 5-15 miles away the weight added is too insignificant to alter array of the results. I suggest we alter weight of the proximity a bit furthen and anything within 15 miles proximity should have higher impact on the score.

Example: If I search for Clermont from {{GEOSEARCH.API.URL}}/v1/geoplaces/lookup?lat=39.6959&long=-86.285694&take=1000&q=clermont, I get this array of results with corresponding weights:

1.

"displayName": "Clermont, GA, US", - "score": 23.671813656201824

-

"displayName": "Clermont, IA, US", -  "score": 23.49322166413671

-

"displayName": "Clermont, IN, US", - "score": 24.6209556920414

But if I search for Clermont from {{GEOSEARCH.API.URL}}/v1/geoplaces/lookup?lat=39.8156&long=-86.315&take=1000&q=clermont, I get a different array of results already

-             "displayName": "Clermont, IN, US", - "score": 29.594651620974496

-             "displayName": "Clermont, FL, US", - "score": 25.20769061423452

-             "displayName": "Clermont, GA, US", - "score": 23.671445284495377

These two locations are only few miles apart and should get same order.

comments.author: Yu-Sheng Tu
comments.body:
The new changes will make distance between 15 mile and up to 30 ~ 40 miles radius result more relevant weight in their score.

This is the mongo score boost calculation: score boost = pivot in meter / (pivot in meter + distance meter)
and the current default pivot is 5miles (~8045meters)
higher pivot value will result in further drop off range.

issues.summary: Implement fingerprint-based Redis cache keys for GolfNow invoice responses
issues.description:
We updated the Redis key generation logic for GolfNow invoice responses to use a fingerprinting strategy. Instead of embedding every input parameter directly into the cache key, we now hash the normalized inputs (client username, channel ID, tee time ID, email, player count, and fee overrides) into a SHA256 fingerprint.

The cache key format is:

commerceproxy:golfnow:invoice:{typeName}:{fingerprint}

Benefits:

- Shorter and more consistent keys

- Eliminates subtle bugs caused by input formatting or ordering

issues.summary: Support Tax-Inclusive Pricing in Commerce Workflow
issues.description:
Enhanced the Commerce workflow to support tax-inclusive pricing models when generating ExternalChargeLineItem data for GolfNow API integration.
Key updates include:

- Adjusted distribution logic to properly split tax-inclusive amounts into pre-tax and tax portions.

- Ensured accurate handling of IsTaxIncluded throughout the reservation and fulfillment workflows.

- Preserved compatibility with existing tax-exclusive processing.

- Updated internal data structures and comments for clarity and maintainability.
issues.descriptionHtml:
Enhanced the Commerce workflow to support tax-inclusive pricing models when generating ExternalChargeLineItem data for GolfNow API integration.
Key updates include:

  • Adjusted distribution logic to properly split tax-inclusive amounts into pre-tax and tax portions.

  • Ensured accurate handling of IsTaxIncluded throughout the reservation and fulfillment workflows.

  • Preserved compatibility with existing tax-exclusive processing.

  • Updated internal data structures and comments for clarity and maintainability.

comments.author: Tyler Olechnowicz
comments.body:
QA Testing Instructions: Tax-Inclusive Pricing Support

Objective:
Validate that the ExecuteFulfillment endpoint in the Commerce Proxy API correctly handles both tax-inclusive and tax-exclusive pricing scenarios. This endpoint internally calls the ExternalOrderCheckout endpoint in API 2.1 and records charges and distributions accordingly.

---
Step 1: Toggle Tax Inclusivity

To simulate tax-inclusive or tax-exclusive pricing, update the IsTaxIncluded flag on the golf course:

Enable tax-inclusive pricing:

USE [CRM];
GO

UPDATE dbo.CRMGolfCourseAttribute
SET IsTaxIncluded = 1
WHERE GolfCourseId = 131266;

Disable tax-inclusive pricing (tax exclusive):

USE [CRM];
GO

UPDATE dbo.CRMGolfCourseAttribute
SET IsTaxIncluded = 0
WHERE GolfCourseId = 131266;

Also ensure the TaxClassification.IsTaxInclusive flag is set appropriately in the fulfillment request payload depending on your test case:

"TaxClassification": {
"IsTaxInclusive": true, // or false
"TaxClassificationId": "GREEN_FEE_COURSE_GN",
"TaxRate": 0.065,
"TaxOverrides": {
"FlexCode1": "Course",
"FlexCode2": "",
"FlexCode3": "17266"
}
}

Note: Tax-inclusive pricing results in a lower total amount paid (e.g., $50 flat), while tax-exclusive pricing will add tax on top (e.g., $50 + $3.25).

---
Step 2: Execute Fulfillment

Send a test request to:

POST /api/fulfillment/execute

Update the base URL to the appropriate test environment if needed.

---
Step 3: Validate Results in Database

After fulfillment, verify that charges and distributions were recorded correctly:

USE [CRM];
GO

SELECT TOP 100 *
FROM dbo.CRMChargeDetail
ORDER BY ChargeDetailID DESC;

SELECT TOP 100 *
FROM dbo.DistributionDetail
ORDER BY DistributionDetailId DESC;

SELECT TOP 100 *
FROM dbo.InvoiceItemDetail
ORDER BY InvoiceItemDetailID DESC;

---
Expected Results

- Tax-Inclusive Pricing:

- No CRMChargeDetail rows for sales tax

- No DistributionDetail rows for sales tax

- All tax is embedded in the main item price (e.g., green fee or cart fee)

- Tax-Exclusive Pricing:

- Separate CRMChargeDetail rows for sales tax

- Corresponding DistributionDetail rows for the tax portion

QA Testing Instructions – RemoveItem Endpoint

Please follow the steps below to validate the behavior of the RemoveItem endpoint:

- Generate a Client Token:

- Call the GenerateClientToken endpoint to obtain a new client-token header for authentication.

- Invoke the RemoveItem Endpoint:

- Use the RemoveItem endpoint to simulate removing a tee time from the cart.

- Set the Correct Fulfillment Source Name:

- For course times, set Source.Name to "gn-course-time".

- For trade times, set Source.Name to "gn-trade-time".

- Verify Endpoint Behavior:

- If the request is valid and all checks pass, the response should return IsExecutionSuccessful = true.

- If there are any issues, the response should return IsExecutionSuccessful = false along with a FailureReason.

- Invoice Cache Handling:

- If a cached invoice exists for the request (e.g., from a prior CreateInvoice call), confirm that the RemoveItem call successfully clears the cached invoice.

- Since there is no additional business logic involved (e.g., no tee sheet hold removal), you’re primarily validating that the endpoint returns a 200 OK response and behaves as expected.

- Generate a Client Token:

- Invoke the ModifyItemQuantity Endpoint:

- Set the Correct Fulfillment Source Name:

issues.summary: Fix null reference exception in reservation workflow when transportation type is not set on rate set (Commerce-initiated reservations)
issues.description:
A NullReferenceException is being thrown during the reservation workflow for reservations initiated via the Commerce workflow. The issue occurs when the associated rate set does not have a transportation type set.

Observed Behavior

- Reservations created through the Commerce workflow trigger a NullReferenceException during the reservation workflow execution.

- The exception occurs specifically when the rate set’s transportation type is null or not set.

Expected Behavior

- The reservation workflow should safely handle cases where the transportation type is not set.

- Workflow execution should not fail due to missing or unset optional configuration values.

Proposed Fix

- Add proper null checks around transportation type usage within the reservation workflow.

- Apply fallback logic (if applicable) or return a clear, descriptive error message instead of throwing.

Steps to Reproduce

- Configure a rate set with no transportation type set.

- Initiate a reservation via the Commerce workflow.

- Observe the NullReferenceException.

Additional Notes

- Issue affects Commerce-initiated reservation paths.

- Occurs only when transportation type is not set on the rate set.

issues.summary: Timelyst - MongoDB Atlas Triggers
issues.descriptionHtml:
Create Mongo Atlas Triggers for collection FacilityDiscoveryQueue and ServiceAvailabilityQueue. To process queue items and generate the read only FacilityDiscovery documents and ServiceAvailabilitySnapshot documents for frontend.

FacilityDiscoveryQueueTrigger.js

/**
 * MongoDB Atlas Trigger: FacilityDiscoveryQueue
 *
 * This trigger monitors the FacilityDiscoveryQueue collection for Insert and Update operations.
 * When a document with Status = "Pending" is detected, it calls the API endpoint to process it.
 *
 * Trigger Configuration:
 * - Trigger Type: Database
 * - Collection: FacilityDiscoveryQueue
 * - Operation Types: Insert, Update
 * - Full Document: On (whenAvailable or updateLookup)
 * - Document Preimage: Off
 */

const BASE_URL = "https://timelyst.dev.golfnow.io";
const ENDPOINT = "/api/v1/management/facilities/discovery-queue/{id}/process";
const TIMEOUT_MS = 10000;

const QueueStatus = {
  Pending: 0,
  Processing: 1,
  Completed: 2,
  Failed: 3
};

/**
 * Main trigger function
 * @param {Object} changeEvent - The change stream event document
 */
exports = async function(changeEvent) {
  const functionName = "FacilityDiscoveryQueueTrigger";
  const correlationId = new BSON.ObjectId().toString();

  console.log(`[${functionName}] Processing change event. CorrelationId: ${correlationId}`);
  console.log(`[${functionName}] Operation Type: ${changeEvent.operationType}`);
  console.log(`[${functionName}] Document ID: ${changeEvent.documentKey._id}`);

  try {
    // Get the full document
    const fullDocument = changeEvent.fullDocument;

    if (!fullDocument) {
      console.log(`[${functionName}] No full document available. Skipping.`);
      return { success: false, reason: "No full document available" };
    }

    // Check if Status is "Pending" (0) - only process pending items
    // Status can be numeric (0) or string ("Pending") depending on BSON serialization
    const status = fullDocument.Status;
    const isPending = status === QueueStatus.Pending || status === "Pending";

    if (!isPending) {
      const statusName = typeof status === "number"
        ? Object.keys(QueueStatus).find(key => QueueStatus[key] === status) || status
        : status;
      console.log(`[${functionName}] Document status is '${statusName}' (${status}), not 'Pending'. Skipping.`);
      return { success: false, reason: `Status is ${statusName}, not Pending` };
    }

    // Extract FacilityId from the document
    const facilityId = fullDocument.FacilityId;
    if (!facilityId) {
      console.error(`[${functionName}] FacilityId not found in document.`);
      return { success: false, reason: "FacilityId not found" };
    }

    // Convert ObjectId to string if necessary
    const facilityIdStr = facilityId.toString ? facilityId.toString() : facilityId;

    // Get document _id for the API URL
    const documentId = changeEvent.documentKey._id.toString();

    console.log(`[${functionName}] Processing DocumentId: ${documentId}, FacilityId: ${facilityIdStr}`);
    console.log(`[${functionName}] TriggerSource: ${fullDocument.TriggerSource || 'N/A'}`);

    // Build the API URL using document _id
    const apiUrl = `${BASE_URL}${ENDPOINT.replace("{id}", documentId)}`;
    console.log(`[${functionName}] Calling API: ${apiUrl}`);

    // Make the HTTP POST request
    const startTime = Date.now();
    const response = await context.http.post({
      url: apiUrl,
      headers: {
        "Content-Type": ["application/json"],
        "Accept": ["application/json"],
        "User-Agent": ["Timelyst-AtlasTrigger/1.0"],
        "X-Correlation-ID": [correlationId],
        "X-Trigger-Source": ["atlas-trigger"],
        "X-Document-Id": [changeEvent.documentKey._id.toString()]
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        DocumentId: documentId,
        FacilityId: facilityIdStr,
        OperationType: changeEvent.operationType,
        TriggerSource: fullDocument.TriggerSource,
        Timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
      }),
      encodeBodyAsJSON: false
    });

    const duration = Date.now() - startTime;

    // Log the response
    const statusCode = response.statusCode;
    const responseBody = response.body ? response.body.text() : "";

    console.log(`[${functionName}] API Response - Status: ${statusCode}, Duration: ${duration}ms`);

    if (statusCode >= 200 && statusCode < 300) {
      console.log(`[${functionName}] Successfully processed FacilityId: ${facilityIdStr}`);
      return {
        success: true,
        facilityId: facilityIdStr,
        statusCode: statusCode,
        duration: duration,
        correlationId: correlationId
      };
    } else {
      console.error(`[${functionName}] API call failed. Status: ${statusCode}, Response: ${responseBody}`);
      return {
        success: false,
        facilityId: facilityIdStr,
        statusCode: statusCode,
        error: responseBody,
        duration: duration,
        correlationId: correlationId
      };
    }

  } catch (error) {
    console.error(`[${functionName}] Error processing change event: ${error.message}`);
    console.error(`[${functionName}] Stack trace: ${error.stack}`);

    return {
      success: false,
      error: error.message,
      correlationId: correlationId
    };
  }
};

issues.summary: GAM Interstitials
Interstitial Analytics API
issues.description:
Front end teams need a more “transactional” method to log analytics for the GolfPass interstitial flow because Google Analytics has proven to be unreliable. This project consists of:

- An API that the front end will call to log impressions and add to cart events

- Database to store this data so it can be exported to raptor and the business can have accurate data for their products

- ReservationMetadata additions for more contextual data

- UI work to call this API in the interstitial workflow
issues.descriptionHtml:
Front end teams need a more “transactional” method to log analytics for the GolfPass interstitial flow because Google Analytics has proven to be unreliable. This project consists of:

  • An API that the front end will call to log impressions and add to cart events

  • Database to store this data so it can be exported to raptor and the business can have accurate data for their products

  • ReservationMetadata additions for more contextual data

  • UI work to call this API in the interstitial workflow

issues.summary: ReferenceType Data Cleanup/Requirements
issues.description:
- We need a ReferenceType table

- Convert enums below to rows in the table

- Add two new ReferenceTypes

- Reservation Redemption

- Product Redemption

- Expose the Description value from Loyalty.Action in the /loyalty-balance-history API

- Name the field: ActionDescription

- Expectations for Redemptions:

- ReferenceID of the Reservation Redemption should be the ReservationID of the reservation where the points were redeemed

- ReferenceID of the Product Redemption should be the CustomerSubscriptionID of the product where the points were redeemed

- ReferenceID of earned reservations should be the ReservationID of where the points were earned

- Data clean up

To be determined: How do we want to reference Points for Actions? Example: If you book 2x, which ReservationID should be referenced?
issues.descriptionHtml:
1. We need a ReferenceType table

    1. Convert enums below to rows in the table

  2. Add two new ReferenceTypes

    1. Reservation Redemption

    2. Product Redemption

  1. Expose the Description value from Loyalty.Action in the /loyalty-balance-history API

    1. Name the field: ActionDescription

  2. Expectations for Redemptions:

    1. ReferenceID of the Reservation Redemption should be the ReservationID of the reservation where the points were redeemed

    2. ReferenceID of the Product Redemption should be the CustomerSubscriptionID of the product where the points were redeemed

    3. ReferenceID of earned reservations should be the ReservationID of where the points were earned

  3. Data clean up

To be determined: How do we want to reference Points for Actions? Example: If you book 2x, which ReservationID should be referenced?

issues.summary: Results for matches with apostrophes are inconsistent
issues.description:
We fixed results returning matches ignoring apostrophes in previous work but I’m seeing some inconsistencies still.

For example, when searching for Talking Stick Golf Club - O'odham with entries like ood, oodh, oodha, oodham - all but one are returning results just fine.

Need to research why this particular case with 4 characters entries ooda is not returning the match.

Another interesting case: search for Golf de l'Hermitage with entries like hermi, hermit, hermita you literally need to type Hermitag to get relevant results. But when you type Hermita - nothing comes back. Here is also observed an interesting behavior whenere if you already typed Hermitag and result came back, then if you keep deleting character by character - your given result of Golf de l'Hermitage will still persists.

comments.author: Yu-Sheng Tu
comments.body:
for the case of Talking Stick Golf Club - O'odham, ood, oodh, oodha, oodham works because it match with the token generated from O'odham, ie oodham → ["o", "oo", "ood", "oodh", "oodha", "oodham"]. However, it will fail for ooda because we required the full length of the input to matched the prefix of the token to get the most accurate results.

Potential fix : change { prefixLength: searchTerm.len - 1 } to allow at most 1 edits to the search term to give more room for error due to misspelling. However, this may cause single character search term to product less accurate result, ie saddle c or southern r.

NOTE : change is specific to facilities and not geolocations.

- Display the T&Cs checkbox exactly the way we currently do with the Tee Time T&Cs appended

We can see in the FinDash, this card hard two charges for the amount of the tee time between the dates of 4/18 and 4/22 (date of payment and date of refund) and their associated order numbers.

Orders 426828861 and 426827891 are associated with the same tee time, paid via SmartPlay (426827891 has since been manually refunded)

GNC booking details, for posterity (https://golfnowcentral.com/Reservation/Edit/403703380)

Findings from Pugh:

- Tested on RC2 to see if i can double hit the Submit button. You cannot. However once you submit a check in then return to the reservation details, the check in button stays visible for a few seconds while the API refreshes it self. On RC2 it was VERY slow but thats normal, prod its much faster but i imagine still technically possible a user could have re clicked it

- The bigger issue is that once i did the first check in on the app, i then went on the API to submit again. The API allowed a one player booking. To have 3 submissions for the same slotnumber. This seems like a VendorService validation issue. You should not be able to get an invoice or purchase for a BookingId/SlotNumber combo that is already checked in and paid. This used to error out because i vividly remember forgetting to change slot numbers whne i tested APIs. The error I used to get was something like “The slot you are attempting to check in already has an associated order”

Acceptance Criteria:

Need to prevent multiple submissions for the same slot number via the API.

Provide an error message to the user should multiple submissions be detected.

We can see in the FinDash, this card hard two charges for the amount of the tee time between the dates of 4/18 and 4/22 (date of payment and date of refund) and their associated order numbers.

Orders 426828861 and 426827891 are associated with the same tee time, paid via SmartPlay (426827891 has since been manually refunded)

GNC booking details, for posterity (https://golfnowcentral.com/Reservation/Edit/403703380)

Findings from Pugh:

  • Tested on RC2 to see if i can double hit the Submit button. You cannot. However once you submit a check in then return to the reservation details, the check in button stays visible for a few seconds while the API refreshes it self. On RC2 it was VERY slow but thats normal, prod its much faster but i imagine still technically possible a user could have re clicked it

  • The bigger issue is that once i did the first check in on the app, i then went on the API to submit again. The API allowed a one player booking. To have 3 submissions for the same slotnumber. This seems like a VendorService validation issue. You should not be able to get an invoice or purchase for a BookingId/SlotNumber combo that is already checked in and paid. This used to error out because i vividly remember forgetting to change slot numbers whne i tested APIs. The error I used to get was something like “The slot you are attempting to check in already has an associated order”

Acceptance Criteria:

Need to prevent multiple submissions for the same slot number via the API.

Provide an error message to the user should multiple submissions be detected.

issues.summary: Prepaid Send Order to Interface Order Not Created in Golf365 Pro With Certain Notes (Character Count Over 100)
issues.description:
Issue:

Angeles National (SpaID 36944). Reported an issue where an Online Prepaid Booking (Send Order to Interface), was did not create a booking within Golf365 Pro.  Upon further investigation, the reservation in question did have a decently long booking note.  Attempted to use the same note for an online prepaid booking and could recreate the issue where the order was not created within Golf365 Pro.  Still have not pinpointed the exact issue around the note - but it does appear that the note is what is causing the issue.

Example from Angeles National:

Aaron Bradley

Booking Date/Time:  7/31/2025 6:04:28 PM

GNC Rate Set: Angeles National - 10 bw BE; Sent Order to Interface: ON, IsTaxIncluded: OFF

Steps to Reproduce:

Tested in Production at Golfnow Links East.

Utilized the BE link: https://golfnow-links-east.book.teeitup.com/

Utilized the ‘Links East Prepaid’ rate set.

Reservation # 411135843 was made with the exact same note as from Angeles National:
'im purchasing this for somebody else so I will not be there to play. The guests name that will be checking in and playing is Josh Joines and his son Tyler Joines.'

This booking resulted in no order being created within Golf365 Pro.

Reservation # 411136005 was made on the same rate set, but with no booking note and an order was created as expected within Golf365 Pro. (OrderID 458149160)

Reservation # 411137437 was made on the same rate set, but with a very short booking note:
'This is a booking note.'
An order was created as expected within Golf365 Pro. (OrderID 458155257)

Reservation # 411137689 was attempted again with the same booking note form Angeles National, just to confirm that no order is created and again, no order was created within Golf365 Pro.

Note: These bookings have since been refunded.

After further testing this appears to be related to a booking note that is longer than 100 characters. A note shorter than 100 characters will created the order, and longer than 100 will note create the order.

Acceptance Criteria:

Determine and resolve why some notes are preventing order from being created within Golf365 Pro.

If a note is able to be entered on the BE, then Golf365 Pro should be able to handle that note and allow the order to be created successfully.

issues.summary: Native language spelling not returning results
issues.description:
Searching by the native language spelling is not returning the expected results. Both of these spellings are considered Alternate names according to GeoNames.

- Bruxelles is the native language spelling for Brussels

- https://www.geonames.org/2800866/brussels.html

- The same happens for Muechen and Munchen which are the native language spellings for Munich

- https://www.geonames.org/2867714/munich.html

Resolution :

- explore adding specific language analyzer base on country code.

- using GeoName’s Alternative Names, run the search against it.

Pre-release steps

- Run GeoName postmigration to add alternate names for cities above 1M populations.

require a discussion on the trade off of this resolution. cc @Brian Pugh

Possible options are only introduce alternative names to certain cities. (maybe above certain population thresh whole)

issues.summary: Update POI and GeoLocation search aggregation
issues.descriptionHtml:
1. We want to remove “near me” locations from the search result. For example : when user search for “belfast” it shouldn’t display location that is near the user, should only display location that is the most relevant to the searched term.

  2. Course Name matching should rank higher then city name match. (Aberdelghy Golf Club should be the first rank course).

Solution:

  1. Remove the lat/long “must” aggregation from the GeoLocation search query.

  2. Update PointOfInterest search query to look for

    1. “must”

      1. “should” relevant to “Name” and “SearchKey” field, where “SearchKey” only weight 20% to the score.

      2. apply “near” to the score

Example query : 

should: [
      {
        compound: {
          must: [
            {
              compound : {
                should : [
                  {
                    autocomplete: {
                      query: "tpc",
                      path: "Name",
                      fuzzy: {
                        maxEdits: 2,
                        prefixLength: 3,
                        maxExpansions: 100
                      }
                    }
                  },
                  {
                    autocomplete: {
                      query: "tpc",
                      path: "SearchKey",
                      fuzzy: {
                        maxEdits: 2,
                        prefixLength: 3,
                        maxExpansions: 100
                      },
                      score : {
                        boost : {
                          value : 0.2
                        }
                      }
                    }
                  }
                ] 
              }
            },
            {
              near: {
                origin: {
                  type: "Point",
                  coordinates: [
                    -81.37923, 28.53834
                  ]
                },
                pivot: 100000.0,
                path: "Address.Position"
              }
            }
          ]
        }
      }
    ]

issues.summary: Update the maxGrams of search index to 10
issues.descriptionHtml:
Issue 1 (Lookup call): Exact matches are not shown unless you type full or almost full entry. Mount Dora should be already shown here but it isn’t, look like it’s only shows up when third character of the second word is entered:

This should be treated like a full match from first and second word and not separately when first word entry is matched up but then we are waiting for that third character of the second word to identify a match.

Requirement:

  1. Update autocomplete search index to 

    {
  "foldDiacritics": true,
  "maxGrams": 10,
  "minGrams": 3,
  "type": "autocomplete"
},

  2. Update the prefixLength for autocomplete to take the max length of the search text OR 10 (maximum).

    new BsonDocument
{
    { "autocomplete", new BsonDocument
    {
        { "query", text },
        { "path", "Name" },
        { "fuzzy", new BsonDocument
        {
            { "maxEdits", MAX_EDITS },
            { "prefixLength", prefix_len },
            { "maxExpansions", 256 }
        } }
    } }
},

issues.summary: Apply Population to the search score
issues.description:
Issue 2(City call): Looks like “Weight ranking” of the destination is not accounted for or ignored. See how top results are two tiny cities with 2 and 8k of population when the third result (Orlando) should have way more priority/”weight ranking”: (We are using city call in a secondary search bar for setting a new location for special rates pages/sections)

Requirement:

City with higher Population value should rank higher in the search result, for example, Los Vegas, NV, US should be above Los Vegas, NM, US.

Ideas:

Generate a NormalizedPopulationvalue that takes the minimum and maximum Population value and update each record with a new value between 0 to 1. This will allow us to apply the value to the score with a boost.

issues.summary: Document All Trade Times Updates From Inventory Automated Refresh
issues.description:
As part of the inventory automated refresh, the revenue team needs a way to track which facilities are being “refreshed” vs which ones are part of the normal cache manager process.

To do this we need to stamp the CRMTeeTime.TTHistory whenever a time is refreshed.

Currently, we do this for other updates such as Times that were updated from cache manager or even for pricing updates as a result of Automated Trade Pricing etc.

Here is an example of what it looks like when a trade time is updated via CM existing flow:

“Tee Time inserted by system based on this TeeTimeID : _______” similarly we know tee times come from the AL when they say:
”Tee Time inserted by system based on TeeTimeLoadID: _______”

---
Requirements:

- Ensure that the TTHistory column is updated whenever we block a trade time from the Inventory Automated Refresh process with text such as: "New Tee time inserted by InventoryAutomatedRefresh based on TeeTimeID : @NewTeeTimeID -@Date"

- Format is "TeeTimeID: 1017362785 - March 30 2024"

- For the newly created TeeTimeID we need to include text such as:
”Tee Time Inserted by InventoryAutomatedRefresh based on this TeeTimeID: @PreviousTeeTimeID”

- CRMTeeTimeAttributes - For all tee times that are “refreshed” we are adding a new CRMTeeTimeAttribute value. AttributeID = 3 - This attribute ID will only be on the newly created, refreshed tee times and not the blocked ones.
issues.descriptionHtml:
As part of the inventory automated refresh, the revenue team needs a way to track which facilities are being “refreshed” vs which ones are part of the normal cache manager process.

To do this we need to stamp the CRMTeeTime.TTHistory whenever a time is refreshed.

Currently, we do this for other updates such as Times that were updated from cache manager or even for pricing updates as a result of Automated Trade Pricing etc.

Here is an example of what it looks like when a trade time is updated via CM existing flow:

“Tee Time inserted by system based on this TeeTimeID : _______” similarly we know tee times come from the AL when they say:
”Tee Time inserted by system based on TeeTimeLoadID: _______”

Requirements:

  1. Ensure that the TTHistory column is updated whenever we block a trade time from the Inventory Automated Refresh process with text such as: "New Tee time inserted by InventoryAutomatedRefresh based on TeeTimeID : @NewTeeTimeID -@Date"

    1. Format is "TeeTimeID: 1017362785 - March 30 2024"

  2. For the newly created TeeTimeID we need to include text such as:
    ”Tee Time Inserted by InventoryAutomatedRefresh based on this TeeTimeID: @PreviousTeeTimeID”

  3. CRMTeeTimeAttributes - For all tee times that are “refreshed” we are adding a new CRMTeeTimeAttribute value. AttributeID = 3 - This attribute ID will only be on the newly created, refreshed tee times and not the blocked ones.

issues.description:
This ticket is part 2 of https://golfnow.atlassian.net/browse/CORE-11679 which is the GNC configuration of GolfCourseID’s.

We are introducing a new feature to GNC that aims to enhance the management of trade times by preventing them from rolling and blocking within a configurable timeframe before their expiration.

Requirements:

- Configurable By GolfCourseID: The feature must be configurable at the GolfCourseID level, allowing for granular control over which courses have this feature enabled.

- UI Toggle for Master Facility GolfCourseID’s: A toggle should be introduced in the "Configure Rate Sets" section of GNC for Master Facility GolfCourseID’s only. This toggle will enable or disable the feature for specific rate sets.

- TimeFrame Not in GNC: We should not add any timeframe field in the UI that allows users to change the minutes before expiration. this should only be editable via database updates to prevent unnecessary risks from user udpates.

- Default Configuration: We will start with all courses turned off except for all master facility GolfCourseID’s with the GCRemoteSystem of ‘EZL’. Also the default timeframe should be 3 minutes

Acceptance Criteria:

- The feature is fully functional and configurable at the GolfCourseID level within the GNC UI.

- The feature accurately prevents rolling and blocking of trade times within the specified timeframe before expiration.

issues.summary: Enhancing Cache Manager for Dynamic Trade Time Re-allocation
issues.description:
Description

The Revenue team seeks enhancements to the existing Cache Manager system to enable dynamic re-allocation of trade times. Currently, Cache Manager does not effectively handle scenarios where trade times, initially set for optimal periods, are moved to less favorable times due to limited availability (blocking and rolling). The proposed enhancement aims to allow the system to "look back" at intervals near the original load-in time and re-allocate trade times to these slots if they become available.

---
Scenario

- Initial Condition: Trade time is set for 10 AM, 7 days in advance.

- Current Limitation: Due to limited initial availability, the trade time is moved to 3 PM, impacting trade price negatively.

- Desired Enhancement: When availability opens up (e.g., between 9:30 AM and 11 AM), the Cache Manager should dynamically move the trade time back to this window if it remains unsold. Preferably, we should move Trade time back into original slot if its available or any Open slot around it prioritizing the closest available time from original loaded time.

---
Action Items

- Analysis: Review the current functionality of the Cache Manager to identify limitations in handling dynamic re-allocation.

- Design: Develop a strategy for Cache Manager to monitor and respond to changes in tee time availability.

- Implementation: Update Cache Manager with the new functionality.

- Testing: Ensure the updated system accurately detects availability changes and reallocates trade times appropriately.

---
Refresh requirements

- Always prioritize rolling back to original trade time that was loaded if possible

- If not, roll to nearest trade time in front of or behind the original if its not available

- Ignore all Rack Rate Fences when rolling. If we need to hop a fence to get back to original trade time that’s fine. Cache Manager will prevent rolling over fences after the rollback occurs and time is opened

- Unsold Trade time rounds can be rolled and split up into different times

- Example: if original time is 9am and current is 11am and closest rounds to original are 9:00  1 player, 9:10 3 players and 9:20 4 players, I would expect the 11am tee time to roll back as follows:
1 player at original 9am and 3 players at 9:10am

- If any players are sold at all in the tee time DO NOT ROLL Back at all. Leave as is.

Also wanted to note that we need to document in the tee time history when this “Inventory Refresh” happens. Please be sure to have this process documented in the History with a line item similar to how we have other processes.

Example: for the Trade Roll we document it as follows: “Created By Trade Roll Functionality”

For this process, can we say: “Created By Inventory Automated Refresh from TeeTimeID(s): ___________,__________” If its not possible to list out the TeeTimeID’s then that’s fine.

Notes:
If trade time moves back within 3 hours of original load time then prevent all further blocks and rolls.

Limit the splitting of unsold rounds to 2 players only. No singles.
If no 4somes within 3 hours forward and 1 hour backwards of original load time then split it up.

Customizable by GolfCourseID

CRMConfig for for the 3 hour window

comments.author: Yoel Martin Pardo
comments.body:
Note: Please reach out to @Joshua Marquess  if you need any clarification of this ticket.

Important note:  If we want to enable Cache Manager enhancement for for Dynamic Trade Time Re-allocation you'll need to insert record into this table TradeTimeRefreshConfig and set the Active flag to be 1. To check what data you need to insert check below. To disabled it you can remove all the records or set the Active flag to 0.

You’ll need to create AutoLoad Scheduled and run the AutoLoad task in order to run through this process.

AutoLoad insert records into CRMOriginalTradeTime table that is the one that stores the Original Trade Times that we are going to use.

Here are some details and basics scenarios for testing:

Inventory Automated Refresh
Purpose:
Trade times that get pushed into the afternoon due to morning blocks usually are sold at much lower prices, which reduces the revenue collected. Moving times back to the morning will often result in more sales and higher sale prices.
Add optimal rolling functionality even when the current trade time is still open. Currently rolling only happens when current trade time becomes blocked.
Move trade as close to the ORIGINAL Load time. NOT THE EARLIEST OPEN TIME.

Key Components:
Configurable Threshold
Only purpose is to put a limit on when to stop rolling
IF current time is already INSIDE threshold window. Do NOT ROLL
Based on Original Load Time of Trade (8:00am)
Threshold to be in 2 parts: (minutes prior and minutes after)
AFTER: Original time + X (where x is in minutes and can be configured in CRMConfig)
BEFORE = Original time - X ( where x is in minutes and can be configured in CRMConfig)

Example configuration:
3 hours After original
1 hour before original

Inside threshold window would be:
7-8am or 8-11am

LOGIC:
If trade time moves back within 3 hours of original load time then prevent all further blocks and rolls. LOCK IT IN PLACE
Limit the splitting of unsold rounds to 2 players only. No singles.
Target keeping trade as a 4some first BEFORE splitting
If no 4somes within 3 hours forward and 1 hour backwards of original load time then split it up.

Requirements
Roll trade back to closest time to Original as possible
Target keeping player rules same when rolling vs splitting up trade. Ex: 4somes should look to roll back to another 4some instead of splitting up
Only split up players if no 4some is available within threshold
Trade INSIDE threshold will no longer roll unless BLOCKED
If there is no trade inside threshold still roll closer to original time
Prefer keeping 4somes together
Don’t split up partially sold trade times
Use the original AL loaded time as the original time stamp
Manually loaded trade will not move because it does not have an AL original time
Abide by fence logic

Scenarios:

**All scenarios are based on an Original Load Time of 8:00am**
Original Trade is 8:00am
New Trade is at 1:00pm 4 players - UNSOLD

8:00am reopens 4 players
Expected result: Trade rolls all players back to 8:00am

8:00am reopens 2 players only
Expected Result: 2 players roll back to 8:00am and 2 stay at 1:00pm

8:00am & 12:00pm reopens 2 players each
Expected Result: 1:00pm rolls back to each (2 @ 8:00 & 2 @ 12:00)

8:00am & 8:30am & 12:00pm opens 2 players each
Expected Result: 1pm rolls back to 8:00am and 8:30am NOT 12:00pm

8:00am opens 3  players only
Expected Result: Roll back ONLY 2 players to 8:00am (limiting rollbacks to avoid singles)

8:00am opens 1 player only
Expected Result: Don’t roll back at all

1:00pm trade has 3 players - Remains Open
8:00am opens 4 players
Expected Result: roll all 3 players to 8:00am

8:00am opens 2 players
Expected Result: Don’t roll at all because it would leave a single

New Time is Partially SOLD and still open
Expected Result: DO NOT ROLL AT ALL (unless it blocks)

New Time is UNSOLD
1:00pm trade time has 4 players - Remains Open
Original Load time is 8:00am
FIRST: 10:50am Opens 4 players - Roll all 4 players to 10:50am
THEN 8:00am opens 4 players - DO NOT ROLL because Trade time has already rolled into the 3 hour threshold

New Time is UNSOLD
1:00pm trade time has 4 players - Remains Open
Original Load time is 8:00am
8:00am opens 2 players & 10:30am opens 4 players
Expected Result: roll all 4 players to 10:30am Keep 4 players together if possible.

New Time is UNSOLD
1:00pm trade time has 4 players - Remains Open
Original Load time is 8:00am
FIRST: 11:10am opens 4 players - Roll all 4 players to 11:10am (THRESHOLD NOT MET - Can keep rolling) 3 hours and 10 minutes from OG time
THEN: 7:30 am opens 2 players & 8:30am opens 2 players
Expected result: Split 4some up into 2 @ 7:30 and 2 @ 8:30

New Time is UNSOLD
1:00pm trade time has 4 players - Remains Open
Original Load time is 8:00am
7:30 am opens 2 players & 8:30am opens 2 players & 11:10am opens 4 players
Expected result: Split 4some up into 2 @ 7:30 and 2 @ 8:30 because 11:10 is outside of threshold
Prefer rolling trade INSIDE threshold over OUTSIDE threshold

We have created TradeTimeRefreshConfig table that is the configuration of threshold for Facility or GolfCourse level.

If we have a record like the one below. That means that all the GolfCourses on that facility are going to use the same configuration

But if we have a record specifying the GolfCouse, then we’ll use the configuration for that specific GolfCouse.

Get The Values from TradeTimeRefreshConfig table:

SELECT * FROM TradeTimeRefreshConfig

To add records into TradeTimeRefreshConfig

INSERT INTO TradeTimeRefreshConfig (PlayFacilityID,GolfCourseID,MinutesBefore,MinutesAfter,Active,CreatedOn,CreatedBy,LastModified)
VALUES ( 1806, 160195, 60, 180,1, GETUTCDATE(), 1, GETUTCDATE()),
( 1806, NULL, 30, 180, 1, GETUTCDATE(), 1, GETUTCDATE())

( PlayFacilityId, NULL or GolfCOurseId, 'Minutes before Original Trade time', 'Minutes after Original Trade time', Active or Not, GETUTCDATE(), UserId, GETUTCDATE())

comments.author: Dewan Kabir
comments.body:
Update on the ticket :

The Core team is working on adding a new change to the ticket  where we will be tracking the fulfilled tee times from the Original Trade Time table in CRM . This will help us in tracking which tee times were fulfilled and based on the re-openings of the tee times on the tee sheet .

As in if we have tee times being opened back up on the tee sheet , applicable CRM Tee Times based on the threshold rules will be used to Fulfill the Original Trade Time Tee Times .
And this new change will track those fulfilled original trade times , so we know which next original trade tee time is going to be fulfilled and what pervious CRM Tee Times were used to fulfilled the Original Trade Time Tee Times .

We may have the Original Trade Tee Time removed from the table once removed or we may have the player rule for that tee time updated to 0 , when fulfilled .

issues.summary: Prevent Blocking/Rolling of Trade Times Within "X" Window of Time Before Expiration
issues.description:
NOTE: This ticket is changing the following:
Change CM to prevent trade from blocking and also rolling within a configurable amount of minutes before the expiration time.

NOTE: The main requirement of this ticket is to Prevent Cache Manager from rolling and blocking (meaning we force it to stay open) within “x” minutes. We can start with 5 minutes.

It needs to be configurable by GolfCourseID. We will default with all courses turned off unless I hear otherwise. I will just write the script to turn certain courses on until the UI is built in GNC

We currently have an issue where we are seeing Trade times that should be expired, blocking and rolling at the time they would expire to a new future time.

We need to create a toggle in GNC Configure Rate Sets (for Master Facility GolfCourseID’s only) that stops rolling expired times in the future.

---

This is TICKET PART 1 which is only for the Cache Manager Changes

---

Requirements:

- This should be enabled at the rate set level

- only allowed to be turned on for Master Rate sets

- One field added to Configure Rate Sets that has an empty text field for integers.

- If there is an integer in the field then that sets the threshold

- if Blank then set to 0 - no changes

- Cap the minutes change to 15 minutes

Important note for dev and testing:
This should not affect trade times that block and roll due to other reasons besides expiration. Example, if a trade time becomes unavailable before it expires, we should still block and roll as expected.

issues.summary: Inventory Automated Refresh Threshold Issue with NULL GolfCourseID
issues.description:
There is an issue whenever the TradeTimeRefreshConfig table does not have a record in the GolfCourseID table, then it does not grab any of the rate sets under that playFacilityID to pull in the results for Inventory Automated Refresh (IAR).

To test this, make sure there is a playfacilityID entered in the TradeTimeRefreshConfig table but without a GolfCourseID . You should now be able to see Inventory Refresh working whereas it would not work before due to the bug in the code.
