comments.author: Yoel Martin Pardo
comments.body:
QA: Below are the steps to test this ticket.

*Test with TradeTimeRefreshConfig where we have populated the PlayFacilityID, but GolfCourseID is NULL.

Note: Delete all the TradeTimeRefreshConfig to start fresh and also I will recommend to use EZL teesheet because we can simulate the TeeSheet inventory.

1-Run Sql script below, just replace the GolfFacilityID with the value from the GCPlayFacilityID column of the GolfCourse that you are testing with.

INSERT INTO TradeTimeRefreshConfig (PlayFacilityID,GolfCourseID, MinutesBefore,MinutesAfter,Active,CreatedOn,CreatedBy,LastModified)
SELECT GolfFacilityID ,NULL, 60, 180, 1, GETUTCDATE(), '1', GETUTCDATE()

2-Create an AutoLoad Schedule to 10:24 AM for the next day and run it. Make sure a record was created on CRMOriginalTradeTime table for that time.

3-Create a RackTime for 15:24 PM same day and Run Cache Manager. Cache manager should block 10:24 AM teetime and move it to 11:00 PM and also it should create a new Teetime at 15:24 PM.

4-Create another RackTime for 12:48 PM same day and Run Cache Manager. The Inventory Automated Refresh process should create a teetime at 12:48 PM and block and roll the 15:24 PM teetime to 11:00 PM. This was not happening before because the issue.

*Test with TradeTimeRefreshConfig where we have populated the PlayFacilityID and GolfCourseID.

Note: Delete the TradeTimeRefreshConfig created on the first test.

1-Run Sql script below, just replace the GolfFacilityID with the value from the GCPlayFacilityID column and also the GolfCourseID of the GolfCourse that you are testing with.

INSERT INTO TradeTimeRefreshConfig (PlayFacilityID,GolfCourseID, MinutesBefore,MinutesAfter,Active,CreatedOn,CreatedBy,LastModified)
SELECT GolfFacilityID ,GolfCourseID, 60, 180, 1, GETUTCDATE(), '1', GETUTCDATE()

2-Create an AutoLoad Schedule to 10:24 AM for the next day and run it. Make sure a record was created on CRMOriginalTradeTime table for that time.

3-Create a RackTime for 15:24 PM same day and Run Cache Manager. Cache manager should block 10:24 AM teetime and move it to 11 PM and also it should create a new Teetime at 15:24 PM.

4-Create another RackTime for 12:48 PM same day and Run Cache Manager. The Inventory Automated Refresh process should create a teetime at 12:48 PM and block and roll the 15:24 PM teetime to 11:00 PM.

*Test with TradeTimeRefreshConfig where we have populated the PlayFacilityID and GolfCourseID and also another record to have just the PlayFacilityID  populated.

Note: Delete all the TradeTimeRefreshConfig

1-Run Sql script below. Remember replace the GolfFacilityID and GolfCourseID as requested.

INSERT INTO TradeTimeRefreshConfig (PlayFacilityID,GolfCourseID, MinutesBefore,MinutesAfter,Active,CreatedOn,CreatedBy,LastModified)
VALUES (GolfFacilityID ,NULL, 30, 60, 1, GETUTCDATE(), '1', GETUTCDATE()),
(GolfFacilityID ,GolfCourseID, 40, 120, 1, GETUTCDATE(), '1', GETUTCDATE())

Note: See that we have updated the MinutesBefore and MinutesAfter for the record that has the GolfCourseID populated. When we have the two records, we are going to always use the one that has the specific GolfCourseID, unless that is not active.

2-Create an AutoLoad Schedule to 10:24 AM for the next day and run it. Make sure a record was created on CRMOriginalTradeTime table for that time.

3-Create a RackTime for 12:20 PM same day and Run Cache Manager. Cache manager should block 10:24 AM teetime and move it to 11:00 PM and also it should create a new Teetime at 12:20 PM.

4-Create another RackTime for 10:48 AM same day and Run Cache Manager. The Inventory Automated Refresh should not do anything at all because the 12:20 PM is still inside the Threshold (120  MinutesAfter because it is for the GolfCourse ).

5-Update the MinutesAfter for the records with theGolfCourseID populated from 120 to 60 and run Cache Manager again. Now the Inventory Automated Refresh should block and roll 12:20 PM to 11:00 PM and create a new teetime at 10:48 AM

Note: Other test that you can do is similar to this one, but instead updated MinutesAfter for the record with theGolfCourseID, you could disable it and we should be using the TradeTimeRefreshConfig for the record with PlayFacilityID and GolfCourseID as NULL.

issues.summary: Product T&Cs Templates - Database
issues.description:
- Template Id

- Template Name

- This will be a friendly name exposed to end users assigning it to a PPID

- Example: Free Trial Discounted Product

- Template Body

- This will be the boiler plate language

- This will be HTML

- There will be data variables in the body

- Template Relation to ProductPriceId

- This needs to be assigned to a ProductPriceid

- The data here is exposed in https://golfnow.atlassian.net/browse/CORE-13299

- Template Relation to Owner

- One PPID can be purchased on multiple channels but the T&Cs need to be different based on the channel it was purchased

- Context

- One PPID can have multiple context templates depending on channel configuration template because the UI experience for displaying these two require completely different copy

- Context 1 = standalone

- Context 2 = interstitial/sidecart/tee time workflow

- Variables Needed:

- Use the structure of {0}, {1}, {2}, etc. because this is what the UI teams already support

- UI Button Name

- Use {0} since the UI teams already use this

- No logic needed, the UI teams will no how to handle this

- Billing Start Date

- Logic in https://golfnow.atlassian.net/browse/CORE-12806

- Use {1} since the UI teams already use this

- Currency Code

- This is the CurrencyCode of the Product

- Use {2} since the UI teams already use this

- Product Price

- This is the price of the invoiced product

- {3}

- RenewalProductPrice

- This is the price of the renewal product

- {4}

- Product Name

- This is the Product Name from the database

- {5}

- Subscription End Date

- This is the expected EndDate based on a purchase made today

- If the StartDate of the subscription is 9/9/2025, and its a 7 day free trial, the expected value of this would be 9/16/2025

- This needs to account for when you already have a membership

- Example: I have an active annual subscription with an EndDate of 12/31/2025, if im trying to purchase another annual subscription ahead of time on 9/9/2025, i would expect this value to = 12/31/2026

- {6}

- Status

- Active

- Inactive

- Do we need a Version# in here?

- Data Update needed to add TemplateId to applicable PPIDs in prod

- Data to be inserted: https://nbcuni-my.sharepoint.com/:x:/g/personal/206466075_tfayd_com/EZ95rIJ3rspIi7zsnklcPOQB5XxUVigWOB5_HMdBgHHCHA?e=m8WA3Q

- You cannot have two configurations for a single PPID that has matching OwnerId and ContextId

- Example: PPID 140, OwnerId 331, ContextId 1 can only have one body of text

  6. Context

    1. One PPID can have multiple context templates depending on channel configuration template because the UI experience for displaying these two require completely different copy

    2. Context 1 = standalone

    3. Context 2 = interstitial/sidecart/tee time workflow

  7. Variables Needed:

    1. Use the structure of {0}, {1}, {2}, etc. because this is what the UI teams already support

    2. UI Button Name

      1. Use {0} since the UI teams already use this

      2. No logic needed, the UI teams will no how to handle this

    3. Billing Start Date

      1. Logic in https://golfnow.atlassian.net/browse/CORE-12806

      2. Use {1} since the UI teams already use this

    4. Currency Code

      1. This is the CurrencyCode of the Product

      2. Use {2} since the UI teams already use this

    5. Product Price

      1. This is the price of the invoiced product

      2. {3}

    6. RenewalProductPrice

      1. This is the price of the renewal product

      2. {4}

    7. Product Name

      1. This is the Product Name from the database

      2. {5}

    8. Subscription End Date

      1. This is the expected EndDate based on a purchase made today

      2. If the StartDate of the subscription is 9/9/2025, and its a 7 day free trial, the expected value of this would be 9/16/2025

      3. This needs to account for when you already have a membership

        1. Example: I have an active annual subscription with an EndDate of 12/31/2025, if im trying to purchase another annual subscription ahead of time on 9/9/2025, i would expect this value to = 12/31/2026

      4. {6}

  8. Status

    1. Active

    2. Inactive

  9. Do we need a Version# in here?

  10. Data Update needed to add TemplateId to applicable PPIDs in prod

    1. Data to be inserted: https://nbcuni-my.sharepoint.com/:x:/g/personal/206466075_tfayd_com/EZ95rIJ3rspIi7zsnklcPOQB5XxUVigWOB5_HMdBgHHCHA?e=m8WA3Q

  11. You cannot have two configurations for a single PPID that has matching OwnerId and ContextId

    1. Example: PPID 140, OwnerId 331, ContextId 1 can only have one body of text

comments.author: Lara Golovachenko
comments.body:
Conclusion:

- Besides returning now much larger number of close or true mathes, which is unavoidable in this case, the only minor concern I have is the one that when true exact matches returned from multiple countries they won't be sorted to your proximity at all. Our proximity order is only working on ranges up to 50 miles but not within a certain countries but in general. Thus, Melbourne, Australia will be returned to you first almost no matter where you are in USA. You literally need to be within 5mi radius of Melbourne, FL to see Meulbourne, FL come up in typeahead results first. This is also heavily influenced by population of Melbourne, AU which is over 5 million people vs Melbourne, FL which is only 87k.

- Another note is that if you type International postal codes that only containing 4 digits you will see a US postal results always come up first. And if you have more than 10 exact matches then you won't be able to see what you were actually looking for. Example: postal 1211in Czech Republic will not be even shown in top 5 so will need to be expanding this section:

Another example postal 3900 - you will get results for France, Mexico and Spain, but never see for Switzerland or Australia.

issues.summary: Add Datadog Configs
GolfPass Double Opt In - Tee Time Checkout
issues.description:
We are legally required to have a clearer validation that the customer agrees to the T&Cs in full view (not under a hyperlink) for a GolfPass purchase. We are also required to make it obvious that the purchase button is performing two actions.

Design: https://www.figma.com/design/fWwwb5pUjr2qLSm4HpVnfH/GP-T%26Cs?node-id=1394-6799&t=Grg4ThhBU5kxPoYx-0

- The best reference will be to use the website as reference since this is where the data comes from and the project is already complete.

Opt Into Sidecart Workflow

- When a user ignores the interstitial and opts in to sidecart on the checkout screen

- Open a modal

- The modal data will come from the same API as interstitial and sidecart

- Clicking the Remove from Cart button should close the modal and opt out of sidecart

- Clicking the Confirm button should close the modal and opt into sidecart

- Once fully agreed to and opted in, change the Book Now button to: Reserve & Subscribe

Opt into GP through Interstitial Workflow

- When a user opts in to GolfPass through Interstitial

- When you arrive on checkout, the modal should already be opened

- All modal details are the same as above

- Once fully agreed to and opted in, change the Book Now button to: Reserve & Subscribe

Member pricing Workflow

- Member Pricing workflow as a non-member

- The bottom sheet that currently displays the member pricing warning (Current below) now needs to be removed. It is expected that the new web API will provide the data to match the existing design as well as the new one that displays both the warning about requiring a GP Membership as well as the new GP offer/T&Cs info with new buttons

- The Remove from Cart button will be changed to “Remove from Cart & Choose New Rate” and link back to search results

- Once fully agreed to and opted in, change the Book Now button to: Reserve & Subscribe

Other Details

- If the user is an existing member, do not display the modals or change Book Now button

- If the user is a non member and does not opt in to GP, do not display the modal or change Book Now button

- If the user opts into interstitial or sidecart on one tee time, then backs out and finds a new tee time, we have current functionality to automatically opt you into sidecart on all subsequent checkout pages

- We need to make sure the double opt in modal appears on every checkout visit or checkout page refresh

- Any time you opt in to sidecart, the double opt in should appear. Removing and adding repeatedly should repeatedly display the double opt in

- I believe this is configurable - On UK and AU, we do not have the opt in cached if you back out

- This does not apply to standalone product checkout

- Please reference the website workflows to validate unit testing and QA testing

issues.summary: Include the Trade Rate Fence Logic into Inventory Automated Refresh CM Logic
issues.description:
Revenue team has noticed that there many instances where trade times are refreshing according the threshold but jumping the rate fences which is causing trouble with courses who are sensitive to the exact time of their trade.

Originally, adding rate fence logic to CM for IAR was out of scope but since adding the majority of facilities to IAR, we are seeing an increased number of instances where this is causing strife at the course.

Consequently, we need to ensure that on top of the threshold, we also add in the ability to ensure that we are not bypassing a rate fence.

issues.summary: New Endpoint - Return Customer PaymentMethodKeys
issues.description:
As the Payment Platform I need and endpoint which I can call that will return the PaymentMethodKeys corresponding to the available credit cards within a GolfNow customer’s wallet so that I may present the same options if/when loading the Payment UI for a user that has used GolfID authentication.

- Request input to accept GolfID Token

- Response body to include the PaymentMethodKeys for each credit card wallet option in the customer’s wallet.

- If there is a credit card wallet option that does not yet have a PaymentMethodKey association within CRM, the GolfNow system would call Payment API to store the credit card and generate the PaymentMethodKey that is to be returned.
issues.descriptionHtml:
As the Payment Platform I need and endpoint which I can call that will return the PaymentMethodKeys corresponding to the available credit cards within a GolfNow customer’s wallet so that I may present the same options if/when loading the Payment UI for a user that has used GolfID authentication.

  • Request input to accept GolfID Token

  • Response body to include the PaymentMethodKeys for each credit card wallet option in the customer’s wallet.

    • If there is a credit card wallet option that does not yet have a PaymentMethodKey association within CRM, the GolfNow system would call Payment API to store the credit card and generate the PaymentMethodKey that is to be returned.

issues.summary: Expose AvailableValue and IsEffective Fields from Loyalty.Transaction Table on Loyalty History API
issues.description:
In an effort to help customers get a clearer understanding of Loyalty points, transactions, balances, etc, the business would like to display the available points value for each transaction on customer accounts.

In order for the front end team to do this, we will need to expose the AvailableValue field from the Loyalty.Transaction table. We also need to expose the IsEffective field so they can indicate to customers when the points are pending (IsEffective = 0), or available for redemption (IsEffective = 1).
issues.descriptionHtml:

We also need to expose the IsEffective field so they can indicate to customers when the points are pending (IsEffective = 0), or available for redemption (IsEffective = 1).

issues.summary: Loyalty Service - Future Proof Business Requests - Create New Table
issues.description:
The business would like to assign additional Loyalty points based on various actions such as watching a video, completing a competition, referring a friend, reactivating GolfPass, etc. This ticket is to ensure we ‘future proof’ our systems and processes to be able to handle these various requests.

To do this, we’ll need to create two new tables to store the configuration related to flat points values based on program and channel.

The first table should include:

- ActionID

- Action

- Description

- Filtering

Example:

ActionID

Action

Description

1

SmartPlay Check In

User completes smartplay mobile check in

2

GP+ Reactivation

User has reactivated GP+ based on XYZ criteria from business

3

First Time Booker

User has booked their first reservation on GN/TO

The second table should include:

- ProgramID

- ChannelID

- ActionID (from first table above)

- Need some sort of ID for these that can then be recorded on GolfPass Points Transaction History

- Amount of points being awarded

- Start and End Date for the promotional period (optional)

issues.summary: Loyalty Service - Update Loyalty.RewardTransaction to Include ReferenceType Action
issues.description:
The business would like to assign additional Loyalty points based on various actions such as watching a video, completing a competition, referring a friend, reactivating GolfPass, etc. This ticket is to ensure we ‘future proof’ our systems and processes to be able to handle these various requests.

In https://golfnow.atlassian.net/browse/CORE-11917, we created a new table to store the relevant information for each completed action. Now we need to add an ActionID column to the Loyalty.RewardTransaction in order to differentiate between which action the credit is coming from. This ActionID column will pull in the IdentityID from the new table.

(ActionID column in Loyalty.RewardTransaction table can be named something else to avoid confusion with ActionID in other table)

Assign SmartPlay actions to correct records (separate deployment)

issues.summary: Prevent Duplicate PaymentMethodKey Payment Types from Being Inserted on Each Reservation
issues.description: Currently, when using payment method key payment type as a payment method when making a reservation, a new wallet option is created every time it is used, even if a wallet option with that payment method key has already been created for the customer. We need to prevent duplicate wallet options from being created with this payment type.

issues.summary: Smartplay Fees are not printed on the receipt and email receipt but are included in the GrandTotal
issues.description:
Issue

- Smartplay Fees are not printed on the Itemized Receipt as a separate row but are included in the GrandTotal

Impact Area(s):

- G1.Svc.Order

Preconditions:

- Smartplay Fees are enabled

- CC Surcharge is enabled

Steps to reproduce

- Complete Smartplay order (in the app, or via Postman. I used a Postman)

- Check the printed receipt in G1

- Check the email receipt

Actual result

- Smartplay Fees are not printed on the Itemized Receipt and Email Receipt as separate rows but are included in the GrandTotal.

- The G1 receipt Grand Total is missing the Smartplay fees so the math is incorrect.

Expected

- Smartplay Fees are printed on the Itemized Receipt and Email Receipt in a separate row and are included in the Grand Total.

Attachments

issues.description: Current method of recording auto-renewals is lacking in substance, a single BIT field does not contain enough information. We need a dedicated table for tracking renewal opt-ins, with a row created per opt-in. When a user opts-out of an already opted-in renewal the original record is flagged as inactive. A subsequent re-enabling of auto-renew for a subscription would result in a new record being added, and recording the T&Cs at the time, as well as timestamps, channelId, and any other relevant info to confirm the user opted-in on purpose.

issues.summary: Team representation in Leaderboard UI
Team Assignment that fits with modern Round Management UX - Compete
issues.description:
We’re going to support games and formats where golfers can compete as a team. Below are some combinations of golfers that we might need to support, especially if we expand to support four groups (16 golfers) total:

- max number of teams we need to support is 1/2 of the total number of golfers that can play a game

- current: four different teams to support eight total golfers

- future: eight different teams to support 16 total golfers

- minimum number of teams for any given game should be assumed to be two

- any number of golfers can make up a “team”--even one golfer

- 1 v 3

- 1 v 2

- 2 v 2

- 4 v 4

We should consider having team assignment be a default of the golfer management piece, with all players assigned to a different “team” at the outset.

- whether this is included in the display is up for debate, for UX BEFORE a team game/format is added to the outing round

Team assignment should be visible everywhere that the golfer avatar (and possibly name) is used in UI

- this serves as a constant reminder to which team they’re competing on

Team assignment changes should be as simple to execute as humanly possible

- check inspiration below for ideas

- approach as “minimal taps” on screen before the team change is made

Changes can take place on a dedicated view if the Golfer Management area will not support it

- this might be especially important because Team changes would change Leaderboard(s) for standings of an active round

- for that reason, confirming and/or saving command might be required before we enforce the updates on the outingRound

Team titling and UI should clearly differentiate between one another--ideas for differentiation in combination between UI and backend / DB are:

- all differentiation should be automatic and NOT managed in UX

- title - Team 1, Team 2, Team 3, etc. (or A, B, C...)

- coloration - Blue, Red, Yellow, Green, Purple, Orange, Pink, etc.

- as used in toggles, scorecard rows, leaderboards, podium, etc.

- :question_mark: title and coloration combo should be sufficient but if you have other ideas please feel free to add

Inspiration and Exploration

https://www.figma.com/board/QCbkrcWtubImH05Uh20Nel/Outings-%26-Teams-Exploration?node-id=0-1&t=TqZTogpKs7ZHhtfW-1

- :warning:  this document is dated for Compete UI given we had not moved to Active Round Management, so please capture Compete screens for current version (1.8…) or later to use in designs

issues.summary: API 2.1 - Future Proof Business Requests
issues.description:
In an effort to future proof loyalty requests from the business, we need a way to add points for situations such as watching a video, completing a competition, referring a friend, etc.

One idea is to create a generic endpoint (ex: AddPointsToLoyalty) with a key value to identify the action needed to add points to an account (Ex: ID 1 is mobile check in, ID 2 is watched a video, ID 3 is referred a friend, etc). We would make sure UI and SFMC teams have access to this API so they can trigger it in various journeys.

Keep in mind:

- We’ll want a way to monitor user behavior/prevent abuse (ex: a user has to create a competition AND complete the competition to receive points)

- If points need to be returned, we should give customer service the ability to do this through GNC

issues.description:
Overview - SmartPlay_VuePage_Updates_v1.docx

Pre-Requisite -

- This will use the new Smarplay Settings Page and is tied to the feature toggle

- When the Toggle is off the old Legacy SmartPlay Page is used.

- When the Toggle is On the new Vue Page is used.

- For this ticket this new Vue Page needs show the new Product Lineup with Range Balls and the legacy Featured Products tab.

- At the completion of this ticket, a featured product lineup for range balls should be

- created globally with applicable variants

- displayed in the new SmartPlay vue page for locations (created here - https://golfnow.atlassian.net/browse/GN1-16098)

- added to smartplay settings API

- added to the featured product API call

- At the completion of this ticket, G1 user should be able to

- view range balls lineup (including variants)

- select product for each variant (catalog search)

- The Product Lineup will be a new tab , however we will need to maintain the Featured Products tab as Legacy until all the Product Lineups are completed and locations and brands have transitioned.

Coordination with Core Team

- WE want to get @Brian Pugh the contract as soon as we can send it to QA

- Need to coordinate Core Tickets to update the Contract.

Global Featured Product Lineup

- A lineup will represent a standardized selection of products which will be featured throughout our online channels - This is https://golfnow.atlassian.net/browse/GN1-16001

- For this ticket we are just adding Range Balls 9 (Hard Code)

- These groupings will be managed globally, but in the scope of this ticket, please hard code Range Balls, while we wait on building out the system admin page to create/manage these lineups

- Create a global lineup for “Range Balls”

- Create 4 variants for this global lineup

- Variant 1 = One Size

- Variant 2 = Small

- Variant 3 = Medium

- Variant 4 = Large

- There must be a global ID ( hardcoded) used universally for each lineup and variants to be used across all locations

- Example VendorService Path: POST /v1/{vendorId}/products/featured-lineups

- Example VS Request Body:

-

{
"FacilityId": 1234,
"IncludeOutOfStock": true,
"LimitNumberOfProducts": 1,
"LineupId": [1]
}

- Example VS Response Body (doesnt have to be exactly this but we need the 4 required fields listed):

-

{
"Results": [
{
"LineupName": "Range Balls",  //Required
"LineupId": 1,                //Required
"Variants": [
{
"Id": "9245719",
"Name": "Range Balls - Small Bucket",
"LineupGroupName": Small,  //Required
"LineupGroupId": 1.        //Required
"IsUnlimited": true,
"TagPrice": {
"Amount": 1.5000,
"CurrencyCode": "USD"
},
"SKU": "12993183",
"Unit": "oz",
"Inventory": 0
},
{
"Id": "9245723",
"Name": "Range Balls - Medium Bucket",
"LineupGroupName": Medium,
"LineupGroupId": 2
"IsUnlimited": true,
"TagPrice": {
"Amount": 1.5000,
"CurrencyCode": "USD"
},
"SKU": "12993184",
"Unit": "oz",
"Inventory": 0
}
]
}
],
"Success": true,
"ErrorCode": 0
}

Smart Play Settings Page

- Display range ball lineup on the location SmartPlay settings page

- Add a new tab named “Product Lineup”   – Mike K made this change 2/19

- Display “Range Balls” as a section header

- Display each variant within the Range Balls section

- Allow a user to search and fill each open variant

- Users will be able to search their catalog of products and select different products for each lineup variant

- this catalog search should include all products, not just products that have been flagged as “featured”

- After a product is placed into a lineup, add in a flag that featured products have been “enabled”

- Per walter, this should just be in the code and not displayed anywhere in the UI

- If enabled, this should return “true” in a new field “EnableSmartPlayFeaturedProducts” in the following API

- https://rc2-vendorapi.gnsvc.com/Help/Api/GET-v1-vendorId-facility-facilityId-course-settings

- Alter the follow API to return only products that assigned as a variant to a lineup global ID

- Display global id and variant Ids as part of the API

- https://rc2-vendorapi.gnsvc.com/Help/Api/POST-v1-vendorId-products-featured

- Once a user saves the page, add/update any variant selection

- Mockup shows two different UI options. I like the one on the right personally.

- Mockup

UAC - Added @Yurii Levytskyi

- Enable the New SmartPlay Settings page.

- This enables the new SmartPlay page in Vue

- The user needs to be able to add a Product Lineup for Range Balls,

- There should be 4 Selector boxes:  One Size, Small, Med, Large,

- Each Selector should allow the user to choose any Product.

- The users can choose a non-range ball product but that would not make sense, but they can also set any price they want, we will have help documentation that they need to pick a Range Ball Product and the Range Product can be ERange, Select Pi which is integrations we need to test with this feature.  There can also be a manual process where they fill the bucket manually and there is no integration to a 3rd party Range ball system.

- This will need to be fully tested with Range Balls and Pins once this ticket goes to the Core Team @Geeta Khatri  we need to figure out a way for this to come back to the G1 team for full testing.

- The user needs to be able to view the old Featured Products Page they have previously enabled using the Featured Products Tab.  @Sarah Wolfkiel   I want to keep both tabs in Vue until we build out the full Product Lineup.

- the old way of enabling a featured Product is still working at this point so we should be able to see the items enabled for Featured Products and then use the new Product Lineup for Range Balls configuration.

issues.summary: Cache Manager Unblocking Trade for Inventory Automated Refresh Oversells
issues.description:
There is a revenue impacting bug with Inventory Automated Refresh where Cache Manager is unblocking more trade rounds than allowed that had already “refreshed” other trade times earlier in the day. This issue is potentially causing oversells due to us refreshing new trade times and then opening extra players on the original time.

Scenario:

- 11:00am TT came first

- 11:00am TT creates 10:24 via IAR (Inventory Automated Refresh)

- This refresh takes 2 players from 11:00 and moves them to 10:24 leaving two 2somes (11:00 and 10:24)

- BUG - Then cache manager recognizes that 11:00am (2 players) actually has 4 players on the tee sheet and reopens the trade time to 4players leaving us with 6 players total.

- IAR process continues and attempts to refresh the 11:00am tee time again and will continue to split the trade time up and then unblock on next sync, causing a cycle that can repeat.

---

Visual explanation: You can see in the screenshot where the IAR process removed 2 players and moved them to 10:24, then the line above that is when CM recognizes that the 11am TT actually has 4 players open so it unblocks the full TT. Then the IAR process happens again a couple lines above that.

---
NOTE: this does not happen when all 4 players are refreshed as we are moving those tee times to 11:00pm preventing CM from any further syncing.
issues.descriptionHtml:
There is a revenue impacting bug with Inventory Automated Refresh where Cache Manager is unblocking more trade rounds than allowed that had already “refreshed” other trade times earlier in the day. This issue is potentially causing oversells due to us refreshing new trade times and then opening extra players on the original time.

Scenario:

  1. 11:00am TT came first

  2. 11:00am TT creates 10:24 via IAR (Inventory Automated Refresh)

  3. This refresh takes 2 players from 11:00 and moves them to 10:24 leaving two 2somes (11:00 and 10:24)

  4. BUG - Then cache manager recognizes that 11:00am (2 players) actually has 4 players on the tee sheet and reopens the trade time to 4players leaving us with 6 players total.

  5. IAR process continues and attempts to refresh the 11:00am tee time again and will continue to split the trade time up and then unblock on next sync, causing a cycle that can repeat.

Visual explanation: You can see in the screenshot where the IAR process removed 2 players and moved them to 10:24, then the line above that is when CM recognizes that the 11am TT actually has 4 players open so it unblocks the full TT. Then the IAR process happens again a couple lines above that.

NOTE: this does not happen when all 4 players are refreshed as we are moving those tee times to 11:00pm preventing CM from any further syncing.

comments.author: Yoel Martin Pardo
comments.body:
Steps to recreate the issue:

1-Create an Original Trade Time from AutoLoad (8:00 AM)
2-Create a rack Time at 1:00 PM
3-Run Cache manager.
Cache Manager should be blocking and rolling that teetime from 8:00 AM to 1:00 PM (Please take a look at the roll windows and also remove fences)
4-Keep the RackTime at 1:00 PM  and create another RackTime for 9:00 AM just 12 player rule.
5-Run Cache Manager.
Inventory Automated Refresh should open 9:00 AM teetime with 2 players and block 2 playes from  1:00 PM teetime. (The issue was that we kept the TTOriginalRule with the previous value, in this case 14)
6-Run Cache Manager.
Cache Manager is going to open 1:00 PM with 4 players.

issues.summary: Smartplay | Update Auto-Send to Kitchen APIv2 to Handle Smartplay Orders
issues.description:
Ask:

This is an APIv2 update request based on a previous function that is currently not working in Smartplay.  Based on researching the cause, the APIv2 is not returning order IDs for Smartplay when Auto-Send is enabled for a register.

Currently believe that mobile app has not been updated to to handle the smartplay API because we’re using a separate dependency package:
GolfNow.SmartPlay.WebApi.Interfaces.GolfNowOneSmartPlay

Example of API call.

smartplayClient.GetUnsentOrderIds(locationId, null,null,null)
[get] https://smartplay.gnsvc.com/api/v1/locations/17268/orders/unsent
{"results":[],"isSuccessful":true,"errorMessage":""}

---
Impact Area(s):

- Smartplay

- Golf365 Pro EPOS

- Golf365 Pro Mobile

---
Preconditions:

- Smartplay is enabled

- Auto-Send orders to Kitchen is enabled for the Default Register or designated register for Smartplay orders

---
Acceptance Criteria:

- Smartplay orders are Auto-Sent to a Kitchen Printer and print

---

issues.summary: Orders Screen Refresh
issues.description:
Acceptance Criteria

- In 2022, we updated the getOrder call to a 10 minute schedule for stability concerns. We are looking to implement our original state, with the ipad refreshing every minute and displaying any new orders during that time

- Based on conversations with walter, we would like to implement the following technical plan

- Order screen calls order meta data table every minute

- This  table only contains smartplay orders

- If any new orders are found during this call, fetch the rest of the order information to display on the order screen

- Please check for performance impact when implementing this update

- iPad should auto refresh, and when a new smartplay order come in, it should be 60 seconds max before it shows on the order screen

- Per Ismael, the SmartPlay order screen is refreshed every 2 minutes, please update that screen to refresh every 1 minute. No need for any logic change, just the frequency.

Testing

Can we please add to the testing that given the new update above, that orders are auto sent to the printer? In it’s current state, a user had to interact with the iPad to show the order, and then the kitchen will print. We are hoping this piece will be resolved as part of this update. If it does not, please create a bug ticket to address.

- Log into Mobile App

- Navigate to the Orders Screen

- Log into the GN App

- Make an F&B purchase for selected location

- Navigate back to the Mobile App

Expected Result:

- New F&B order displays on screen within 60 seconds without any user interaction

- Order auto prints to kitchen based on product purchased

  • Per Ismael, the SmartPlay order screen is refreshed every 2 minutes, please update that screen to refresh every 1 minute. No need for any logic change, just the frequency.

Testing

Can we please add to the testing that given the new update above, that orders are auto sent to the printer? In it’s current state, a user had to interact with the iPad to show the order, and then the kitchen will print. We are hoping this piece will be resolved as part of this update. If it does not, please create a bug ticket to address.

  1. Log into Mobile App

  2. Navigate to the Orders Screen

  3. Log into the GN App

Creating Smartplay F&B order

- Use “WS4 RC3” environment and complete authentication

- Run request “Creates an invoice for a Smartplay order” located in QA Workspace → “Smartplay v2 (In Progress)” → “Create Invoice/Booking” folder

- Run request “Complete purchase for a Smartplay order” located in QA Workspace → “Smartplay v2 (In Progress)” → “Purchase” folder

issues.summary: Research - SmartPlay Order Deletion
issues.description:
See the below queries. We are seeing orders that have a “deleted date,” but the is deleted column is 0. we are also showing orders as “open” when they should be closed and is deleted = 0

The orders have a time stamp on the "delete date/time utc," so Walter said there's likely something wrong with updating the order to closed instead of open. there is no "deleted" order status, so they should be in "closed."

Please investigate.

use golfnowone
select
o.SpaID
, s.accountname
, s.name as FacilityName
, o.ordernumber
, o.statusid
, ost.name as OrderStatus
, os.Name as OrderSource
, o.CreatedByUserID
, u.email
, u.username
, o.CompletedByUserID
, DateCompleted
, o.DateCreated
, o.PaymentID
, o.isdeleted
, o.DateDeletedUTC
from dbo."order" o (nolock)
left join dbo.ordersourcelu os (nolock) on o.sourceid = os.id
left join dbo.orderstatuslu ost (nolock) on o.StatusID = ost.ID
left join dbo.spa s (nolock) on o.spaid = s.ID
left join dbo."user" u (nolock) on o.CompletedByUserID = u.id
left join OrderPayment op (nolock) on op.id = o.PaymentID
where s.statusid = 4
and s.isdeleted = 0
and o.IsDeleted = 0

comments.author: Peter Castro
comments.body: The IsDeleted and DateDeletedUTC properties are set in the CreateInvoiceAsync call so that they don’t show up in POS and the Manage Orders page until the PurchaseInvoiceAsync call is done. This is done this way because people may go back and forth from the checkout page without proceeding with their payments and each time you go into the checkout page it creates a new order. So, to not flood the POS and Manage Orders page with new orders the IsDeleted column isn’t updated until after PurchaseInvoiceAsync is called.

issues.summary: [Mobile] Order Screens Refresh
issues.description:
Acceptance Criteria

- In 2022, we updated the getOrder call to a 10 minute schedule for stability concerns. We are looking to implement our original state, with the ipad refreshing every minute and displaying any new orders during that time

- Based on conversations with walter, we would like to implement the following technical plan

- Order screen calls order meta data table every minute

- This  table only contains smartplay orders

- If any new orders are found during this call, fetch the rest of the order information to display on the order screen

- Please check for performance impact when implementing this update

- iPad should auto refresh, and when a new smartplay order come in, it should be 60 seconds max before it shows on the order screen

- Per Ismael, the SmartPlay order screen is refreshed every 2 minutes, please update that screen to refresh every 1 minute. No need for any logic change, just the frequency.

Testing

Can we please add to the testing that given the new update above, that orders are auto sent to the printer? In it’s current state, a user had to interact with the iPad to show the order, and then the kitchen will print. We are hoping this piece will be resolved as part of this update. If it does not, please create a bug ticket to address.

- Log into Mobile App

- Navigate to the Orders Screen

- Log into the GN App

- Make an F&B purchase for selected location

- Navigate back to the Mobile App

Expected Result:

- New F&B order displays on screen within 60 seconds without any user interaction

- Order auto prints to kitchen based on product purchased

issues.summary: Auto-send to kitchen printing is not immediate for SmartPlay F&B Orders
issues.description:
Support/Activation Issue:

Order will come through on the iPad no matter the register, but ONLY after you refresh the the screen by pulling down on the screen. Once refreshed, a red notification with a number will populate on the SmartPlay tab within the orders modules. But no receipt for the order prints, nor with Auto Send to Kitchen setting toggled on within that Area receipt settings

---
In https://golfnow.atlassian.net/browse/GN1-16007  the ask was to have all SmartPlay F&B orders that have  products with hot/cold/bev kitchen assigned auto-print to the kitchen printers. There is currently a delay in this process where orders are not being printed immediately.

It was originally thought that we just need to increase the Order refresh on the order page (https://golfnow.atlassian.net/browse/GN1-13373 ) to make sure the SmartPlay orders being received are being caught ASAP but development asked for an additional ticket to potentially circumnavigate having to constantly look for SmartPlay orders due to performance concerns.

---
Preconditions:

- Smartplay is enabled

- Auto-Send orders to Kitchen is enabled for the Default Register or designated register for Smartplay orders

---
Acceptance Criteria:

- Smartplay orders are Auto-Sent to a Kitchen Printer and print

- If course has KDS enabled smartplay orders are displayed

STR:

- Ipad is on a register that isnt the default register

- Auto-send is off for the default register

issues.summary: Ability to close SP F&B Orders on any register
issues.description:
Acceptance Criteria

- SmartPlay F&B orders come through on the default register – These are Open Orders

- G1 users should be able to close these F&B orders on any other register

- We believe this functionality was lost when we migrated from WS4 to APIv2

- When a user is attempting to close an order on a register with a different payment account than the default display:

- Error: You cannot close the order on this register. Please select a different register.

Discussion

- The focus is SmartPlay F&B, and we want to retain validation for the desktop.

- We will look at the source as validation to allow this.  the idea being we do not want to allow employees to change registers on just any desktop Order, we want to limit this to SmartPlay F&B orders as much as possible!

Testing

- Create an F&B order via the GolfNow App

- View order on the Mobile App

- Update the register on the Mobile App to any register that is not the Default

- Attempt to close the order (hit pay now)

- Close the Register

- Make sure the order shows on the reports under the correct register.

- Check reports: Order Report, Transaction Report, Tax Details report, Sales Report, Cash Register Close, Great Plain Export that the SmartPlay Transaction(s) display.

Expected result

- Order closes with no issue, transferring the F&B order from the default register to the current register

Screenshot and video of error:

comments.author: Desimo Recaido
comments.body:
@Andrew Lounsberry  looks like related to the ticket below. it looks like it is by design and a valid business error. when you purchase smartplay online it uses default cash register and add a preauth payment. when tablet closes the order it captures/finalized payment using the same cash register. different cash register maybe associated to different payment processor providers ETS or GN PMT. you cannot do pre auth using register that uses ETS and capture using register that uses GN PMT. you have to remove the payment and add it again via G1 tablet or desktop.

Acceptance Criteria

- When an order is received for a smartplay menu item, add customer's’s name to the kitchen chit order

- Order.Customer (expandable options) - G1 customer assigned to the order

- Order.OrderMetadata (Customer details provided during create/purchase invoice via Smartplay) - Smartplay customer which can be the same as the assigned order customer if it can be resolve via email and location/brand. Order.Customer is empty when it cannot resolve the G1 customer.

Tablet have all the information they need to include in the kitchen receipt

This is a smart play Order, where on the left we have a customer and on the right, we have a guest

The notes above are dynamically generated for all SmartPlay Orders so this could be entirely on the tablet side, Desimo needs to check if they are getting this info.

The tablet will need to do work also we need to see if we are:

- sending this info to their API (their=mobile: Ipad F&B for Pro)

Alternative idea:

On the Kitchen Receipt, we need to add a new line after all the items that prints the name, phone and email, this would allow the employee to call or text the customer

issues.summary: Smartplay: Get product lines is not applying product line id filter when provided
issues.description:
Issue:

- ProductLineIDs is not applied as filter for get product lines

- IncludeOutOfStock filter is not applied

Impact Area(s):

- G1.Svc.Catalog

- G1.Svc.Api

- Smartplay

Preconditions:

- Product lines are configured accordingly

Steps to Reproduce:

- Add other product lines and corresponding product line categories

- Assign product variants

- Get product line items via postman via G1piV2 or vendor service specifying specific ProductLineIDs or IncludeOutOfStock filter

Actual Results:

- results are the same regardless of whether ProductLineIDs or IncludeOutOfStock  is provided or not

Expected Results:

- results are filtered by ProductLineIDs

issues.summary: Add Featured Product Indicator [rollback]
issues.description:
This feature was released into production on 5/10/2023 in sprint v97.0 (2023MAY09). At 10:30 AM EST DevOps was alerted about increased load on the system which was traced to this ticket.

The change was to stop showing the featured product alert. This was done by removing the demanding query. Currently the alert will never show with the HF change.

Acceptance Criteria:

- The Featured Product Indicator should no longer show in the vue pages

- Create a featured product order on today's date. Go to the online orders page -> set the date range as today -> set type as featured products -> if there exists any records that are not ready, there should still not be a featured product alert.

---
ORGINIAL TICKET REQUEST

Acceptance Criteria

- Display red notification if below conditions are met

- Order exists for “Featured Products” order type

- Order “effective date” is today’s date

- Order is not marked as “Ready”

- Notification Text

- Title = Featured Product Order

- Subtext = Click to fulfill today’s orders!

- Red font, light red background

- Alert icon

- Notification should be present on every vue page

- When clicked, user should be directed to the online orders screen

- Online orders should be pre filtered to: /Orders/Search/Online

- Type = Featured Products

- Effective Date = Today-Today (ex. March 2, 2023 - March 2, 2023)

- If conditions are not met above, notification should be removed

- i.e. all orders is marked as “Ready”

Mockup

Conditions:

- Need to make sure we’re doing a performance review on this ticket

- Reseach into existing functionality

- What happens if there are multiple (currently)

- what happens if there are multiple (now)

- ONLY in vue pages

Test Locations in RC3:

xyz_Briney

xyz_David Clark

xyz_Wingfield

issues.summary: New Featured Product order notification does not appear if user is only navigating between Vue pages
issues.description:
Preconditions

- Featured Product order with Not Ready status and with current day effective date exists on selected location

- Featured Product order notification is visible

Steps to reproduce

- Navigate to Online Orders page

- Set every Featured Product order with current day effective date to Ready

- Create a new Featured Product order with current day effective date

- Wait 10 minutes

- Navigate to any other Vue page (EPOS, Menus, Rainchecks, etc.)

Actual result

- System does not show a notification for new Featured Product order

- User needs to refresh the page manually to be able to see Featured Order notification

- Alternatively User needs to navigate to the Legacy page and back to Vue page to see notification

Expected result

- System displays Featured Product notification after navigating between Vue pages

---
issues.descriptionHtml:
Preconditions

  1. Featured Product order with Not Ready status and with current day effective date exists on selected location

  2. Featured Product order notification is visible

Steps to reproduce

  1. Navigate to Online Orders page

  2. Set every Featured Product order with current day effective date to Ready

  3. Create a new Featured Product order with current day effective date

  4. Wait 10 minutes

  5. Navigate to any other Vue page (EPOS, Menus, Rainchecks, etc.)

comments.author: Nick Heiting
comments.body:
I did 6 rounds of load testing locally in JMeter (3 tests with old code querying db every request and 3 tests with new code that uses Redis caching) , getting active notifications from 50 distinct locations. Every 30 seconds, I made 50 concurrent requests. Each round of testing was 15 minutes long

Previous Code (release 58 branch in g1.svc.management; 20230509 release)

Test 1/3: 1351 requests; average response time of 3.202 seconds

Test 2/3: 1436 requests: average response time of 0.989 seconds

Test 3/3: 1400 requests: average response time of 1.918 seconds

New Code w/ Redis Caching (devlop branch; release v100)

Test 1/3: 1450 requests; average response time of 0.773 seconds

Test 2/3: 1400 requests; average response time of 2.143 seconds

Test 3/3: 1350 requests; average response time of 2.846 seconds

The performance differences do not seem convincing at first, but perhaps in rc3 or rc4 they will be. This may be because of hardware difference, differences in the numbers of orders in my local database, or simply because the 50 locations I tested locally did not have any orders activity (creation, updating, etc) going on when the testing was done, which is not a typical scenario in production.

issues.summary: Customizable transaction fees
issues.description:
Summary

Enable fully customizable, multi-type transaction fees on GolfNow that support custom naming, revenue allocation, discounting, and GolfPass waivability rules, while decoupling fee logic from Tee Time Search to maintain performance and scalability. This epic establishes a flexible fee framework that allows the business to introduce new fee types (e.g., Tourism Fees)

---
Expanded Business Problem

GolfNow’s current transaction fee system is rudimentary around the traditional $2.49 and $3.49 course and hot deal standard fees

- We cannot introduce new fee types (e.g., Tourism Fees, Tafet County Fees, Affiliate Fees) without hard-coded logic

- We cannot enforce nuanced waivability and discount rules, particularly for:

- GolfPass members with Waived Fee Credits

- Fees that must be excluded from all discounts and promotions

---
Goal

Create a fee-type–driven transaction fee platform that:

- Supports multiple distinct fee types

- Each fee has:

- Can be independently named for regional or specific use cases (Tafet Fees, Water Fees) etc.

- A configurable fee type

- Independent behavioral rules

- Example:

- “NYC Tourism Assessment”

- “GolfNow Convenience Fee”

- “Arcis Water Fee”

- Enables advanced fee behavior per fee

- Refundable vs non-refundable

- GP Credit Waivable vs non-waivable

- Flat or percentage-based pricing

- Discountable by:

- Day of week

- Days in advance

- Rate Set rules

- Taxable vs non-taxable

- Preserves the existing revenue allocation flexibility

- Revenue splits configurable per fee

- Supports hierarchical fee configuration

- Owner → Facility → Rate Set

- Rate Set remains the highest override level

- Fee type and name remain consistent while values and rules vary

- Decouples fee calculation from Tee Time Search

- Removes fee logic from stored procedures

- Moves calculation to API/application layer

Architecture note:
CORE-14117 and CORE-14332 are the active implementation foundation for this epic. CORE-14290 has been superseded and should not be used as the basis for future fee retrieval work.

Direction: use the FeeConfiguration/application-layer path, with LaunchDarkly rollout control, and avoid introducing a parallel transaction-fee stored-procedure retrieval path.

issues.description:

https://www.notion.so/GolfPass-Home-Course-3221c22c014480ad9955cda481676933┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                         GOLFPASS HOME COURSE                                 │
│            Make GolfPass+ feel local, personal, and worth renewing          │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌────────────────────────────── WHY THIS MATTERS ──────────────────────────────┐
│ GolfPass+ needs stronger perceived value, especially ahead of a price        │
│ increase. Many golfers — particularly those outside major golf markets or    │
│ those who play the same 1–2 courses repeatedly — may not see enough value    │
│ in the current membership model.                                             │
│                                                                              │
│ Home Course creates a clearer, course-specific reason to join, engage,       │
│ redeem, book again, and renew.                                               │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌────────────────────────────── CORE IDEA ─────────────────────────────────────┐
│ A GolfPass+ member selects ONE participating course as their “Home Course.”  │
│                                                                              │
│ That unlocks a flexible set of benefits tied to that course, such as:        │
│   • Points multipliers                                                       │
│   • Earlier access to barter inventory                                       │
│   • Special course partner perks                                             │
│   • Home Course identity / badging across key surfaces                       │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌──────────────────────────── BUSINESS GOALS ──────────────────────────────────┐
│ 1. Increase retention                                                        │
│ 2. Increase repeat bookings at the Home Course                               │
│ 3. Increase GolfPass Points redemption and loyalty engagement                │
│ 4. Acquire new GolfPass+ members                                             │
│ 5. Grow partner participation from courses                                   │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌──────────────────────────── USER VALUE ──────────────────────────────────────┐
│ “GolfPass gives me better value at the course I actually care about most.”   │
│                                                                              │
│ The experience should help golfers:                                          │
│   • Select a Home Course easily                                              │
│   • Understand what benefits they get                                        │
│   • Know exactly how to use those benefits                                   │
│   • Feel stronger loyalty to both GolfPass+ and their chosen course          │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌──────────────────────────── WHERE IT SHOWS UP ───────────────────────────────┐
│ Home Course should appear across the member journey:                         │
│                                                                              │
│   Profile / Account                                                           │
│   Member Hub                                                                  │
│   Loyalty surfaces                                                            │
│   Booking flow                                                                │
│   Checkout                                                                    │
│   Purchase confirmation                                                       │
│   CRM / lifecycle messaging                                                   │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌──────────────────────────── V1 GUARDRAILS ───────────────────────────────────┐
│ Fixed                                                                        │
│   • One Home Course at a time                                                │
│   • Only participating facilities are eligible                               │
│   • Must be easy to set and manage                                           │
│   • Must clearly explain value and meaning                                   │
│                                                                              │
│ Flexible                                                                     │
│   • Exact perk mix                                                           │
│   • Final points multiplier                                                  │
│   • Mobile vs. web sequencing                                                │
│   • Balance of GolfPass-owned vs. course-owned perks                         │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌──────────────────────────── OUT OF SCOPE ────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Not a broad redesign of:                                                     │
│   • Member Hub                                                               │
│   • Tee time search                                                          │
│   • Profile/account management                                               │
│                                                                              │
│ Also not in scope for v1:                                                    │
│   • Multi-home-course support                                                │
│   • Frequent switching                                                       │
│   • Broad partner ops / contract redesign                                    │
│   • Deep CRM architecture overhaul                                           │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌──────────────────────────── BIGGEST RISKS ───────────────────────────────────┐
│   • Too few courses participate                                              │
│   • Perks are not compelling enough                                          │
│   • Courses do not actively sell/explain the benefit                         │
│   • Golfers do not understand what they get or how to use it                 │
│   • Perk quality varies too much by course                                   │
│   • Loyalty / points logic becomes confusing                                 │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌──────────────────────────── SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE ──────────────────────────────┐
│ Adoption                                                                     │
│   • Members select a Home Course                                             │
│   • Members engage with benefit messaging                                    │
│   • Members use at least one Home Course benefit                             │
│                                                                              │
│ Commercial Impact                                                            │
│   • More repeat bookings at Home Course                                      │
│   • More points redemption                                                   │
│   • Better renewal / retention                                               │
│   • More new-member conversion                                               │
│   • More participating course partners                                       │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌──────────────────────────── RELATED WORK ────────────────────────────────────┐
│   • UXD-909 — GolfPass Member Hub Dashboard on GN App                        │
│   • UXD-1108 — GolfPass Member Hub - Web                                     │
│                                                                              │
│ Home Course should extend Member Hub work — not duplicate it.                │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌──────────────────────────── ONE-LINE POSITIONING ────────────────────────────┐
│ GolfPass Home Course turns GolfPass+ from a broad membership into a more     │
│ personal, course-connected value proposition that can drive loyalty for      │
│ both golfers and participating partners.                                     │

│ Home Course should appear across the member journey:                         │

│   Profile / Account                                                           │
│   Member Hub                                                                  │
│   Loyalty surfaces                                                            │
│   Booking flow                                                                │
│   Checkout                                                                    │
│   Purchase confirmation                                                       │
│   CRM / lifecycle messaging                                                   │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌──────────────────────────── V1 GUARDRAILS ───────────────────────────────────┐
│ Fixed                                                                        │
│   • One Home Course at a time                                                │
│   • Only participating facilities are eligible                               │
│   • Must be easy to set and manage                                           │
│   • Must clearly explain value and meaning                                   │
│                                                                              │
│ Flexible                                                                     │
│   • Exact perk mix                                                           │
│   • Final points multiplier                                                  │
│   • Mobile vs. web sequencing                                                │
│   • Balance of GolfPass-owned vs. course-owned perks                         │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌──────────────────────────── OUT OF SCOPE ────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Not a broad redesign of:                                                     │
│   • Member Hub                                                               │
│   • Tee time search                                                          │
│   • Profile/account management                                               │
│                                                                              │
│ Also not in scope for v1:                                                    │
│   • Multi-home-course support                                                │
│   • Frequent switching                                                       │
│   • Broad partner ops / contract redesign                                    │
│   • Deep CRM architecture overhaul                                           │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌──────────────────────────── BIGGEST RISKS ───────────────────────────────────┐
│   • Too few courses participate                                              │
│   • Perks are not compelling enough                                          │
│   • Courses do not actively sell/explain the benefit                         │
│   • Golfers do not understand what they get or how to use it                 │
│   • Perk quality varies too much by course                                   │
│   • Loyalty / points logic becomes confusing                                 │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌──────────────────────────── SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE ──────────────────────────────┐
│ Adoption                                                                     │
│   • Members select a Home Course                                             │
│   • Members engage with benefit messaging                                    │

issues.description:
Improve the Locked In Trade (LIT) feature to increase revenue flexibility, reduce manual intervention, and eliminate operational risk caused by duplicate schedules, hold management limitations, and lack of system visibility.

---
Reported Issues:

- GNC LIT Management Complications

- Live Holds removal in GNC Update Tee Times is broken

- Dates/rateset reset after adjustments

- Current button times out

- Solution: Create a new UI to manage all LIT holds.

- G1 LIT Management Complications

- No ability to remove holds before trade times are live/bookable

- Cannot move on any days

- Requires G1 access

- Solution: New GNC page will solve this problem as well

- EZL LIT Management Complications (Oversell Issue)

- Too many holds inserted on tee sheet

- Extra holds not reflected in GNC

- Causes overselling

- Double Management of Trade Capacity Schedules

- AL and Hold schedules must manually match

- Duplicate management required

- Solution: Merge the UI for the Hold Period and the Autoload (checkbox)

- Hold Schedule Management Complications (End / Adjust)

- Cannot immediately remove tee sheet holds

- Ending or adjusting schedules does not behave correctly

- Solution: We decided on letting the task do its job and not forcing the holds to come off live. The problem is not having visibility on these holds so the new GNC page above will allow us to see these.

- EZL/G1 LIT Management Complications (60-Day Limit)

- Unable to post LIT holds beyond 60 days

- Solution: Need to discuss with EZL and G1 to research the limitations

- Salesforce SO Blocks Correlation

- SO Blocks do not remove LIT tee sheet holds

- No queue/notification to manually resolve

- Solution: Create Job to Read the CRM.SalesforceBlockTrade and remove from the tee sheet/cancel holds

- CORE-14222

- Hold Schedule Management Complications (No Override/Duplication)

- No override functionality

- No duplication/versioning for schedules

- Solution: Will be resolved when we merge the AL and Hold Periods in the UI

- GNC LIT Management Complications (Visibility)

- No visibility into LIT holds for not-yet-live/bookable trades

- Need future LIT visibility in GNC

- Solution: New GNC LIT screen that will show both the live LIT trade  and posted holds not yet open for sale. Checkbox to “show future LIT Holds”

- EZL LIT Management Complications (Repopulating Holds)

- Manually removed LIT holds repopulate unexpectedly

- EZL/G1 LIT Management Complications (LIT Conversion Bug)

- Adjusting LIT time converts it to standard trade

- No way to move LIT while keeping it LIT
issues.descriptionHtml:
Improve the Locked In Trade (LIT) feature to increase revenue flexibility, reduce manual intervention, and eliminate operational risk caused by duplicate schedules, hold management limitations, and lack of system visibility.

Reported Issues:

  1. GNC LIT Management Complications

    • Live Holds removal in GNC Update Tee Times is broken

    • Dates/rateset reset after adjustments

    • Current button times out

      • Solution: Create a new UI to manage all LIT holds.

  2. G1 LIT Management Complications

    • No ability to remove holds before trade times are live/bookable

    • Cannot move on any days

    • Requires G1 access

      • Solution: New GNC page will solve this problem as well

  3. EZL LIT Management Complications (Oversell Issue)

    • Too many holds inserted on tee sheet

    • Extra holds not reflected in GNC

    • Causes overselling

  4. Double Management of Trade Capacity Schedules

    • AL and Hold schedules must manually match

    • Duplicate management required

      • Solution: Merge the UI for the Hold Period and the Autoload (checkbox)

  5. Hold Schedule Management Complications (End / Adjust)

    • Cannot immediately remove tee sheet holds

    • Ending or adjusting schedules does not behave correctly

      • Solution: We decided on letting the task do its job and not forcing the holds to come off live. The problem is not having visibility on these holds so the new GNC page above will allow us to see these.

  6. EZL/G1 LIT Management Complications (60-Day Limit)

    • Unable to post LIT holds beyond 60 days

      • Solution: Need to discuss with EZL and G1 to research the limitations

  7. Salesforce SO Blocks Correlation

    • SO Blocks do not remove LIT tee sheet holds

    • No queue/notification to manually resolve

      • Solution: Create Job to Read the CRM.SalesforceBlockTrade and remove from the tee sheet/cancel holds

      • CORE-14222

  8. Hold Schedule Management Complications (No Override/Duplication)

    • No override functionality

    • No duplication/versioning for schedules

      • Solution: Will be resolved when we merge the AL and Hold Periods in the UI

  9. GNC LIT Management Complications (Visibility)

    • No visibility into LIT holds for not-yet-live/bookable trades

    • Need future LIT visibility in GNC

      • Solution: New GNC LIT screen that will show both the live LIT trade and posted holds not yet open for sale. Checkbox to “show future LIT Holds”

  10. EZL LIT Management Complications (Repopulating Holds)

    • Manually removed LIT holds repopulate unexpectedly

  11. EZL/G1 LIT Management Complications (LIT Conversion Bug)

    • Adjusting LIT time converts it to standard trade

    • No way to move LIT while keeping it LIT

issues.summary: Timelyst - Duration Based Inventory API
issues.description:
Project Overview

A comprehensive hierarchical inventory supporting calendar view for duration base inventory and booking system supporting real-time availability, dynamic pricing, and resource allocation. Built with **ASP.NET Core 8.0** and **MongoDB**, the platform is split into:

Core Capabilities

- 🏢 Facility Management - Manage physical locations with comprehensive details including address, amenities, operating hours, and timezone support

- 🎯 Offering Management - Define and manage service categories/types within facilities with flexible configuration

- 👥 Resource Management - Handle both facilitators and units with capacity rules and availability tracking

- 📅 Service Definition - Create duration-based services with categorization and tagging

- 💰 Dynamic Pricing - Implement sophisticated pricing rules with:

- Priority-based price points

- Time and date-based conditions

- Channel-specific pricing

- Multiple adjustment types (percentage, fixed, multiplier)

- 📊 Availability Engine - Pre-computed availability slots for optimal performance

- 🎫 Booking System - Intelligent booking with:

- Automatic slot reservation

- Slot splitting and blocking

- Multiple booking modes (Facilitator-only, Unit-only, Combined)

- 🔍 Discovery & Search - Advanced search capabilities with:

- Geospatial search using MongoDB Atlas

- Full-text search with autocomplete

- Multi-faceted filtering

- Location-aware service discovery

Domain Hierarchy

Facility (Physical Location)
├── Offering (Service Category)
│   ├── Resources (Facilitators/Units)
│   │   └── ResourceAvailability (Daily Calendar)
│   ├── Services (Global, Shared)
│   └── RateSets (Pricing Rules)
└── Amenities & Operating Hours

│   ├── Entities/                                 # Domain entities
│   ├── ValueObjects/                             # Value objects

├── GolfNow.Service.Timelyst.ServiceDefaults/     # Shared service defaults
└── GolfNow.Service.Timelyst.Web/                 # Web UI project

issues.summary: GeoPlace 2.0 search result enhancement
issues.description:
This epic will document all the finding in difference compare to the prior implementation and to be address individually in following task tickets

Issue 1 (Lookup call): Exact matches are not shown unless you type full or almost full entry. Mount Dora should be already shown here but it isn’t, look like it’s only shows up when third character of the second word is entered:

This should be treated like a full match from first and second word and not separately when first word entry is matched up but then we are waiting for that third character of the second word to identify a match.

Issue 2(City call): Looks like “Weight ranking” of the destination is not accounted for or ignored. See how top results are two tiny cities with 2 and 8k of population when the third result (Orlando) should have way more priority/”weight ranking”: (We are using city call in a secondary search bar for setting a new location for special rates pages/sections)

Issue 3(Lookup call): Not the best representations and use of search results. When there are no more exact matches to an entry we should display relevant/mistyped or other possible matches rather than the exact match with different postal codes duplicated:

Issue 4(Lookup call): Unexplained/irrelevant matches:

Issue 5 (Reverse lookup call): Bad data. Location name returned is incorrect. We are using this call when determining users location. Here is a location that I was identified at which Orlando (lat: "28.53834", lng: "-81.37923) but name (“Formatted” field) is shown as “Orange”.

Issue 6(Lookup call): Behavioral change from previous logic. When there is no matches that are found we should not display anything, including nearby results. Current prod logic is just to return “No results” message. Please revert that as it was before.

issues.summary: Snyk Remediation
GolfPass Legal Improvements
issues.description:
In order to comply with subscription regulations, we need to expose and store standardized sets of T&Cs for product purchases.

- Create a templating mechanism for legally approved T&Cs

- Be able to assign a T&Cs template to a given ProductPriceId

- Display those T&Cs on Product invoices, Checkout response and GetCustomerSubscription response

- Submit those T&Cs on the CustomerSubscription record

- Create a GNC Page to read/write these templates

- Put behind a RMSPageSecurityGroupException to be able to edit

- Support the T&Cs for renewals

- According to Legal, Renewals are not in scope

- Various data points needed for UI teams to display

issues.summary: Project Bullseye
USGA Course Data Re-architecture for Compete Scoring
issues.description:
Analyzing a new path forward for our connection to and use of USGA course, tee marker and hole-level data.

- remove dependency FOR SCORECARD of mapping USGA courseId to Compete/Grint CourseID

- mappings will be maintained at the course level for hole flyovers

- all scorecard and GPS-scoring tray data would use USGA data via GPA proxies

- cache course, teemarker and hole level data for each individual course when fetched for scorecard services

- invalidate this data if we get a webhook for a data change to the given course
issues.descriptionHtml:

  • remove dependency FOR SCORECARD of mapping USGA courseId to Compete/Grint CourseID
